title: Performance Creative Designer — Static Ads
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Medical Billing Specialist (Remote – Full-Time)
description:
Position Overview



An established Revenue Cycle Management company is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Medical Billing Specialist to join our team in a full-time, long-term remote capacity. The ideal candidate will possess end-to-end expertise across the full revenue cycle, with demonstrated strength in claim submission, payment posting, and aggressive denial management.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Patient Eligibility & Benefits Verification: Verify patient coverage prior to claim submission.

* Demographics & Data Entry: Input accurate patient demographic and insurance information into billing management systems to maintain high data integrity.

* Charge Entry & Coding Accuracy: Enter medical charges efficiently while cross-checking service details against provider documentation.

* Claims Processing & Submission: Prepare, scrub, and submit clean primary and secondary electronic and paper claims to insurance payers.

* Payment Posting & Reconciliation: Post and balance electronic remittance advice (ERA), explanation of benefits (EOB), and patient payments accurately.

* Denial Management & Root-Cause Analysis: Identify, analyze, and resolve claim denials, rejections, and payment variances.

* Appeals & Resubmission Tracking: Draft comprehensive appeal letters, compile clinical supporting documentation, resubmit claims, and systematically monitor status until final resolution.

* Accounts Receivable (A/R) Follow-up: Conduct proactive A/R follow-up with commercial and government payers to eliminate aging balances and maximize collections.



---



Qualifications, Skills, and Abilities



* Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of recent, hands-on experience in full-cycle medical insurance billing and denial management.

* Coding & Terminology: Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS coding standards, and medical terminology.

* Attention to Detail: Meticulous precision in financial entries, coding validation, and documentation.

* Workplace Independence: Proven track record of high productivity, self-discipline, and strong time management in a remote work environment.

* Communication & Problem-Solving: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interface with payers and internal teams.



---

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon accounts.



This is a client-facing role, so the ideal candidate should be comfortable presenting performance updates, explaining strategy, answering client questions, and communicating recommendations clearly.



You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, performance analysis, keyword and targeting expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve sales and advertising efficiency. You will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead to execute account strategies and ensure campaigns are consistently optimized toward client goals.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Perform regular campaign audits and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

* Conduct keyword, search term, competitor, and ASIN targeting research.

* Build and manage brand, non-brand, product targeting, category targeting, and defensive campaigns.

* Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, and product targets.

* Analyze performance across campaign, keyword, search term, and ASIN levels.

* Track key metrics including Spend, Sales, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and Orders.

* Identify high-performing search terms and opportunities for campaign expansion.

* Identify inefficient campaigns and targets and take appropriate optimization actions.

* Monitor budget utilization and ensure spend is aligned with account goals.

* Identify PPC opportunities that can support organic ranking and overall sales growth.

* Consider inventory, pricing, conversion rate, and other factors when analyzing advertising performance.

* Prepare and support weekly and monthly performance reporting.

* Join client calls and present campaign performance, insights, and next steps.

* Explain advertising strategy and performance in a clear and concise way.

* Respond to client questions and provide data-backed recommendations.

* Use AI tools and PPC management software to support analysis, reporting, campaign, optimization, research, and workflow efficiency.

* Clearly document optimizations, findings, tests, and recommended next steps.

* Stay current with Amazon Ads updates and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* At least 5+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience.

* Strong experience managing Amazon advertising accounts.

* Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Strong understanding of keyword targeting, product targeting, match types, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, bids, and budget management.

* Comfortable analyzing advertising data using Excel or Google Sheets.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to diagnose changes in sales and advertising performance and determine potential causes.

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking directly with clients and presenting performance updates and recommendations.

* Ability to communicate complex advertising topics in a simple, business-focused way.

* Comfortable using AI tools, automation, and PPC management software as part of day-to-day campaign management.

* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, platforms, and workflows.



Preferred Experience

* Strong Amazon PPC experience

* Amazon DSP experience is a plus



Performance KPIs

Performance will be evaluated across account results, execution quality, client management, and strategic contribution.

1. Account Performance

* Maintain PPC performance within the agreed client targets for ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, sales growth or profitability.

* Identify declining performance early and take corrective action.

* Improve efficiency or scale spend where opportunities exist.

* Maintain appropriate budget pacing throughout the month.

* Reduce unnecessary spend and continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.



Target: Managed accounts meeting or progressing toward their agreed advertising objectives each month.



2. Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled account optimizations consistently and on time.

* Maintain clean campaign structures and accurate naming conventions.

* Regularly review search terms, keywords, ASIN targets, bids, placements, negatives, and budgets.

* Launch approved campaigns and tests within agreed timelines.

* Ensure campaign changes are properly documented.



Target: Planned optimizations and campaign tasks completed by deadline, with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Testing

* Identify new keyword, product targeting, category targeting, and campaign opportunities.

* Recommend and execute structured tests based on account performance.

* Surface opportunities to scale successful campaigns or products.

* Use PPC data to support broader recommendations around conversion, ranking, inventory, pricing, or listing performance.



Target: At least 2 meaningful growth or optimization recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared to client meetings with clear performance insights and recommended next steps.

* Communicate account changes and issues proactively.

* Respond to client questions accurately and professionally.

* Explain advertising performance in a way that is easy for clients to understand.



Target: Client deliverables completed on time, with no recurring communication or preparedness issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reporting.

* Go beyond reporting metrics by explaining what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.

* Ensure reporting data is accurate and aligned with Amazon Ads and account performance.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate data



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Effectively use approved AI tools, automation, and PPC management software to improve efficiency.

* Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Adopt new tools and workflows introduced by the team.



Target: Consistent use of approved tools and demonstrated improvement in workflow efficiency.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think beyond simply adjusting bids.



You should be able to look at an account and determine:

* Where there are opportunities to grow sales.

* Which keywords or targets should be expanded.

* Where advertising budget is being wasted.

* Which products should receive more advertising support.

* Why sales, conversion, or advertising performance changed.

* Whether performance issues are related to PPC, inventory, pricing, conversion, or other factors.

* What actions should be taken next.

* Where AI, automation, or PPC management tools can help improve efficiency and decision-making.



You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, making data-backed recommendations, and confidently discussing those recommendations directly with clients.



Success in This Role

Success means consistently delivering against client advertising objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, communicating clearly with clients, and managing accounts with minimal supervision.

•Developed an evidence-informed content strategy that links priority patient audiences, approved service messages, organic content pillars and Meta campaign themes to qualified enquiries and bookings.



•Built a dependable monthly content engine that the clinic can implement through clear calendars, briefs, capture plans, asset requirements and approval deadlines.



•Brought all Meta activity into a clear campaign structure, with advertising creative drawn from the approved content strategy, reliable tracking, lead handling and weekly reporting.



•Established a documented compliance and approval workflow so no paid or organic clinical content publishes without sign-off from the nominated clinical approver.



•Delivered a repeatable test-and-learn programme for creative, audiences, offers and landing-page/lead-form paths.



•Improved the quality, speed of follow-up and visibility of qualified enquiries, rather than optimising only for low-cost leads.



How this role works



The manager owns the strategy and the marketing execution. This includes determining the content pillars, campaign priorities, audience messages, content calendar, creative briefs, organic posting plan, Meta ad concepts, campaign setup and ongoing optimisation.



The clinic implements the on-the-ground inputs required by the strategy. This includes making clinicians or team members available for agreed content capture, providing accurate approved information, filming or supplying requested footage when needed, reviewing content promptly, approving clinical claims and offers, and following up leads quickly. The manager turns those approved materials into posts and ads and will make practical recommendations when an asset, landing page or follow-up process is preventing results.



The intended outcome is not simply more content or cheaper leads. It is a coordinated system that attracts suitable local prospects, creates confidence before they enquire and helps the clinic convert qualified enquiries into booked-in patients.



Core responsibilities



1. Own the content strategy and clinic implementation plan



•Develop a quarterly and rolling 90-day content strategy aligned to practice goals, patient demand, seasonality, service priorities, approved claims and available clinic capacity.



•Define priority patient audiences, their likely questions and objections, content pillars, key messages, calls to action, channel roles and the journey from content view to enquiry to booking.



•Translate the strategy into a practical monthly content calendar that specifies each asset, channel, purpose, format, hook, call to action, required approval and owner.



•Create simple, reusable content briefs and shot lists so the clinic team knows exactly what to capture, who needs to participate, what to say or show, and when the material is due.



•Plan how high-performing organic themes and approved clinic assets will be repurposed into Meta ad creative, without treating organic and paid activity as separate silos.



•Review strategy performance monthly and adjust content priorities based on lead quality, booking outcomes, campaign data, practice feedback and changing local demand.



2. Manage social media and turn the strategy into content



•Create platform-native content including short-form video briefs and edits, Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts, captions and calls to action.



•Convert approved practitioner input into simple, empathetic, easy-to-understand patient education. Use plain language and avoid unapproved clinical claims.



•Coordinate efficient content capture with the practice team, including shot lists, filming days, content requests and asset storage.



•Publish approved content, manage scheduling, basic community management and escalation of enquiries to the practice team.



•Track content performance and use insights to improve themes, hooks, formats, posting cadence and calls to action.



3. Plan and manage Meta Ads



•Build, launch and 
 Meta campaigns across
 and Instagram for agreed business goals, such as qualified enquiries, booking requests, new-patient offers or remarketing.



•Structure campaigns, audiences, placements, creative testing and budgets cleanly in Meta Ads Manager.



•Implement and quality-check tracking, including the Meta Pixel, Conversions API where available, event definitions, lead-form fields, UTMs and dashboard inputs. Work with the practice’s web or CRM support when technical changes are needed.



•Create compliant ad copy, creative briefs and landing-page recommendations that match the prospect’s intent and campaign promise.



•Monitor delivery, spend, frequency, creative fatigue, lead quality and conversion outcomes. Make documented optimisation decisions rather than changing campaigns reactively.



•Maintain a testing backlog covering angles, formats, audiences, offers, lead forms and follow-up paths.



•Protect budget by flagging tracking issues, low-quality lead patterns, poor follow-up, compliance concerns or landing-page friction promptly.



4. Keep healthcare advertising compliant



•Use a mandatory pre-publication checklist for every organic post, paid ad, lead form, landing-page copy and promotion.



•Route any clinical claim, practitioner credential, patient-related content, treatment outcome, offer or condition-specific message to the nominated clinical approver before publication.



•Never publish patient testimonials or patient stories that refer to symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, outcomes or practitioner clinical skill. Such content may constitute prohibited testimonials when used to advertise a regulated health service. 



•Do not use unsupported, absolute or outcome-guarantee claims; claims about treating non-musculoskeletal conditions; language that implies a treatment is risk-free; or language that encourages unnecessary treatment. 



•Ensure that any discount, gift or promotional offer has clear, accessible terms and conditions approved by the practice before launch. 



•Keep a dated approval record and a simple creative/claim register for all campaigns.



5. Report, collaborate and improve



•Deliver a concise weekly performance update and a deeper monthly marketing report with insights, actions, tests and decisions required.



•Reconcile Meta platform metrics with the practice’s lead, booking and attendance data wherever available.



•Work closely with reception or the patient-conversion owner to understand lead outcomes and improve speed-to-lead, scripts, reminders and booking conversion.



•Maintain clear files, naming conventions, access documentation and campaign-change logs.



•Bring proactive ideas, while respecting that clinical accuracy and compliance take priority over speed to publish.



Required experience and capabilities



Essential



•3+ years managing social media and Meta Ads for a service business, healthcare/wellness brand or performance-focused agency.



•Proven ability to develop a content strategy and turn it into an implementable calendar, creative brief system, organic social plan and paid-Meta campaign plan.



•Proven ability to manage campaigns from strategy through creative, launch, optimisation and performance reporting.



•Strong hands-on Meta Ads Manager capability, including campaign setup, budget management, audience strategy, lead generation, retargeting, creative testing and reporting.



•Excellent English copywriting and editing. You can explain useful information clearly without hype, clichés or overclaiming.



•Strong short-form content skills, including Canva plus a video-editing workflow such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar.



•Confident analytical ability with Meta Ads reporting, spreadsheets and core marketing metrics.



•Experience using project-management, social scheduling and shared-asset tools.



•A reliable remote-work setup, consistent internet connection, disciplined time management and availability for the agreed Australian-time collaboration window.



•A portfolio or case studies that demonstrate content-strategy judgement, creative work and measurable paid-social outcomes.



Strongly preferred



•Experience marketing an Australian healthcare, allied-health, medical, dental or regulated professional service.



•Practical understanding of Ahpra advertising expectations, or a demonstrated ability to learn and apply a regulated content-approval process quickly.



•Experience integrating Meta lead generation with a CRM, appointment platform, website form or call-tracking process.



•Experience with local-area service marketing and community-oriented social content.



•Experience briefing or coordinating creators, photographers, videographers or front-desk staff for content capture.



What we value



•Sound judgement: you know when a claim needs approval and do not guess.



•Commercial ownership: you care about qualified appointments and revenue contribution, not vanity metrics.



•Craft: your content feels trustworthy, polished and human.



•Curiosity: you test hypotheses and learn from results.



•Calm organisation: you can manage a content calendar, live campaigns and stakeholder input without dropped details.



•Clear communication: you summarise performance, risk and next actions in a way busy practice leaders can use.

title: Instagram DM Setter / Recruiting Appointment Setter
description:

Your primary responsibility will be to have conversations inside Instagram DMs, qualify potential candidates, and book qualified prospects onto our recruiting calendar.

Your job is to start conversations, follow up, handle basic objections, create interest, and BOOK CALLS.

Start conversations with potential insurance agents and salespeople

Send outbound DMs to qualified prospects

Follow our recruiting DM scripts and conversation framework

Ask qualifying questions to determine whether someone is a good fit

Explain our opportunity at a high level without over-selling through DMs

Move qualified prospects toward booking a recruiting call

Send calendar links and confirm appointments

Follow up with prospects who stop responding

Follow up with people who are interested but haven't booked yet

Keep conversations organized and make sure leads do not fall through the cracks

Update prospect information and appointment status inside our CRM/tracking system

Communicate daily with our recruiting and management team

Your Main Goal



Book qualified recruiting calls onto our calendar every day.



We are not looking for someone who simply sends messages.



We want someone who understands that their job is to move conversations forward and turn interested prospects into appointments.



What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely comfortable communicating through Instagram DMs

Fluent in written English

Able to write naturally and conversationally

Fast at responding

Persistent with follow-up without sounding annoying

Comfortable handling objections

Comfortable starting conversations with strangers

Organized and detail-oriented

Competitive and motivated by numbers

Coachable and willing to follow scripts/processes

Able to work independently

Reliable and consistent

Comfortable being measured based on performance



Previous experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



DM setting

Appointment setting

Recruiting

Sales

Lead generation

Instagram outreach

High-ticket sales

Insurance recruiting

How Performance Will Be Measured



Your performance will primarily be measured by:



Number of conversations started

Response rate

Follow-up activity

Qualified prospects generated

Recruiting calls booked

Show rate

Quality of appointments booked



We care about quality AND volume.



Booking 20 unqualified people is not better than booking 10 great candidates who actually show up and are interested.



Schedule



This is a remote position.



You should be available during U.S. Eastern Time hours, especially during the times when our prospects are most active.



Some flexibility may be required because Instagram conversations can happen throughout the day.



Who Will Do Well In This Role



You will probably do very well if you are someone who:



Likes talking to people

Enjoys sales and persuasion

Is naturally competitive

Doesn't get discouraged when people don't respond

Understands the importance of following up multiple times

Can manage hundreds of conversations without becoming disorganized

Wants to grow into a larger sales, recruiting, or leadership role

A short introduction about yourself

Your previous experience with DM setting, appointment setting, recruiting, or sales

How many DM conversations you believe you could realistically manage per day

Your experience booking appointments

Your expected hourly rate

A short voice recording introducing yourself

If someone responds to a recruiting DM with “I'm interested, but I'm already with another insurance agency,” what would you say back?



Please start your application with the words:



“DM SETTER”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and wants to become extremely good at recruiting through social media.

This role is not just about editing videos or posting consistently. The goal is to use short-form content strategically to grow an audience and create opportunities for music discovery.

title: Accounting and business analyst
description:
About us



We are a value-added distributor helping brands establish and grow their presence in Canada and across North America. We work closely with our partners to turn market opportunities into lasting growth.



Our values



Learning is a way of life. We stay curious, actively seek opportunities to learn, and reflect on successes and mistakes—our own and others’. We turn everyday observations, experiences, mistake, and feedback into better ways of thinking, working, and executing.



Turn obstacles into opportunities. Where others see obstacles, we find opportunities. We approach our business with a focus on finding solutions and making the most of every challenge.



Make a meaningful contribution. We create value for our partners and contribute positively to our community.



Welcome change. Drive it forward. We stay open to new ideas, anticipate evolving needs, and take initiative to shape change rather than simply react to it.



Seek excellence and have fun. We strive to deliver the best solutions and be the best at what we do. Excellence without fun is a grind, so we enjoy the journey together.



Human and humble. We are people working for people. We treat others with care and respect, value their perspectives, and remember that we always have more to learn.



Role purpose



Maintain accurate accounting records, and allowing the team on the ground to focus on driving the business while having the peace of mind this will be properly and accurately reflected in the accounting system, this includes but is not limited to. preparing financial and operational reports, Sales orders entry, and work with management and the tax accountant to support cash flow planning, compliance, and budgeting.



Daily responsibilities



Record customer invoices/Credit notes, and Vendor bills/Debit notes



Enter sales orders into the system, providing order desk support for:



Distribution and retail orders.



Marketplace orders for both fulfilled by NAZ and retailer orders shipped directly from NAZ fulfillment center



Market place orders fulfilled by platform 



Reconcile bank activity with invoices/Bills daily to reduce the weekly reconciliation workload.



Flag missing information, errors, and discrepancies to the appropriate person for resolution. Independent resolution may be introduced as experience develops.



Weekly responsibilities



Maintain and update business reports, including:



Vendor and customer backorder reports: Maintain accurate reports with guidance and support from management.



Cash flow report: 



Prepare Accounts payable and accounts receivable lists: Cover the current and upcoming week, showing individual amounts, weekly totals, and overdue balances carried forward and clearly flagged.



Sales reports by channel and brand: Maintain the sales report.



Category budget / cost of goods sold (COGS) report: prepare category performance and cogs turns to support management’s review and planning. The scope and format will be refined using management’s report example.



Reports may require daily updates on an ad hoc basis or move to a regular daily schedule. Additional reports may be introduced as business needs evolve.



Review accounts payable and accounts receivable with management:



Support timely vendor payments and customer collections.



Follow up on overdue or delayed customer payments.



Flag invoice or bill discrepancies and potential payment delays requiring management’s attention.



Discuss proposed vendor payment delays with management; final decisions remain with the business owner.



Ensure bank reconciliation is caught up, and flag outstanding discrepancies or unreconciled items.



Monthly responsibilities



Complete the month-end close and close the books no later than one week after month-end.



Prepare monthly financial statements, including the profit and loss statement (P&L) and balance sheet.



Work with the tax accountant to identify and record required month-end adjustments to support accurate reporting and compliance.



Provide payroll and GST reports and supporting information to the tax accountant to support compliance with applicable filing and remittance requirements.



Manage customer returns and related vendor returns: 



Issue customer credit notes based on the units returned and received.



Coordinate eligible returns to vendors in accordance with each vendor’s negotiated return agreement.



Issue debit notes or request vendor credits or refunds, as applicable under the agreement.



Track customer credits and corresponding vendor recoveries, follow up on outstanding amounts, and flag discrepancies or exceptions requiring management’s attention.



Prepare monthly statements of account to vendors and customers, and comparing with Partner's to reconcile asset, but is not required.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Own the accounting. Help build what comes next.**



We're a growing US-based, technology-enabled services business looking for an experienced Financial Controller to lead hands-on accounting across three related entities.



You'll take ownership of the books, establish dependable reporting, and strengthen the processes behind the numbers. You'll also work directly with business and technical leadership to improve systems and reduce unnecessary manual work.



This role suits someone who brings controller-level accounting judgment, enjoys solving problems, and communicates clearly. You should be comfortable doing the detailed work while helping build an accounting function that can grow with the business.



**What you'll own**



- **Multi-entity accounting:** Maintain accurate books, reconciliations, and intercompany balances across three related businesses.

- **Monthly close and reporting:** Establish a consistent close process and deliver timely financial statements with clear explanations of results.

- **Day-to-day financial operations:** Manage invoicing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payment preparation within appropriate approval processes.

- **Fee and payment accounting:** Ensure customer-specific pricing and payment arrangements are accurately reflected in the books.

- **Cash visibility:** Maintain practical cash forecasts and flag cash needs, unusual balances, and discrepancies early.

- **Processes and controls:** Document workflows, strengthen financial safeguards, and make recurring work more reliable.

- **Systems improvement:** Partner with technical leadership to identify automation opportunities, explain accounting requirements, and verify that improvements work correctly.

- **External coordination:** Prepare organized records and work with outside tax and accounting advisers as needed.



You'll stay involved in the daily work while improving how it gets done.



**What you bring**



- Controller-level skills and experience, shown through meaningful ownership of accounting, monthly close, and financial reporting.

- Strong knowledge of accrual accounting and experience supporting US-based businesses.

- Advanced QuickBooks Online proficiency.

- Experience managing multiple entities, including intercompany transactions and reconciliations.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You can participate confidently in live discussions, write clear updates, ask precise questions, and explain financial issues to non-accountants.

- The ability to investigate discrepancies, work through incomplete information, and recognize when an issue needs clarification or escalation.

- Availability to work a consistent schedule aligned with US business hours, with some flexibility in start and end times.

- A reliable remote-work setup, stable internet, and a practical backup plan.



Experience improving accounting processes, handling complex billing arrangements, or working with software integrations and automation is especially valuable.



**How you work**



- **You follow through.** You keep priorities moving, meet commitments, and surface problems early.

- **You exercise sound judgment.** You investigate before drawing conclusions, document important assumptions, and make unresolved issues visible.

- **You look for practical improvements.** You notice recurring problems and help fix the process behind them.

- **You protect accuracy.** You welcome better tools while maintaining appropriate review, approvals, and accountability.

- **You stay hands-on.** You're comfortable reconciling a difficult account, preparing reports, and discussing improvements with leadership.



**Your first 90 days**



You'll develop a clear understanding of the entities, books, and transaction flows. You'll identify the most important gaps and agree on priorities with leadership.



From there, you'll establish a dependable close and reporting routine, improve cash visibility, document core workflows, and begin implementing practical improvements. Priorities and timing will reflect the condition of the books and the resources available.



**Why join us**



- **Meaningful ownership:** Help shape how the accounting function operates.

- **Direct collaboration:** Work closely with business and technical decision-makers.

- **Practical use of technology:** Help turn recurring manual work into reliable processes.

- **Room to grow:** Develop your responsibilities as the business and accounting function evolve.

- **Fully remote work:** Work from the Philippines with a consistent, agreed schedule.



**Schedule and compensation**



- **Location:** Remote, Philippines.

- **Commitment:** Full-time.

- **Schedule:** US business hours, with a couple of hours of flexibility in start and end times. We'll agree on a consistent schedule during hiring that supports regular collaboration with the US team. This generally means evening and overnight work in the Philippines.

- **Compensation:** Based on experience, accounting capability, and scope of responsibility. Please include your expected monthly compensation in PHP.



**How to apply**



Use this subject line:



**Application – Financial Controller – [Your Full Name]**



We may not review applications that don't use this subject line.



Your
 should include the following.



**1. Résumé (PDF)**

List your accounting roles, the entities and industries you supported, and the systems you used.



**2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)**

Record a short video and share it as a link through Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:

- Who you are and your current or most recent role

- The controller-level work you've owned for a US-based business

- Your experience with QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting

- Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally rather than reading from a script. We want to hear how you explain things.



**3. Written answers to these questions**

- What accounting functions have you personally owned for a US-based business?

- Describe your QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting experience.

- Share one accounting process you improved. What did you change, and how did you verify the result?

- Describe how you resolved incomplete records or a difficult reconciliation.

- Confirm your availability for US business hours, your preferred working hours, your expected monthly compensation in PHP, and your earliest start date.



We won't consider incomplete applications, including those missing the video link or the written answers.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical accounting exercise and discuss their approach in a live interview.



We're looking for someone who makes the numbers dependable, communicates clearly, and helps the business operate better.

title: Senior Video Editor — Cinematic Long-Form + Short-Form Commercial
description:
You Get One Shot. Don't Waste It on Another 7-Second Clip.



You get one shot to make something people will remember for the rest of their lives.



Will you waste it?



Hi, I'm Yewan. Yes, the one writing this job post at 2 a.m. We're looking for someone great. Dare I say, really f*cking amazing at video editing.



We want to make the kind of videos people remember for years. The kind that quietly reset what people think is possible with a camera and a timeline.



But enough about us. Let's talk about you.



---



Where you probably are right now



You're an artist. A storyteller. You can feel when a shot has held one frame too long.



And you're spending your days cutting 30-second clips for a faceless channel, or stitching AI footage together that people will forget before they finish scrolling past it.



Maybe you're freelancing, and every brief says "make it pop" and nothing else. Maybe you're at an agency where editing is the last step in an assembly line, so you get the footage late, the notes vague, and the deadline yesterday. Maybe the best thing you ever cut sits in a private Drive folder because the client went with the version their nephew liked.



You know how to do this at a much higher level. Nobody has asked you to.



If that landed, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role, and we'd rather you know now.



---



What we're actually making



Tulen runs marketing for wedding venues, event spaces, restaurants, and hospitality brands across the US. Places where people have the best nights of their lives.



That's the whole brief, really. Our clients sell moments. Most of the video made about them looks like everyone else's.



We're building two things, and you'd own both:



Cinematic long-form. Luxury vlog storytelling, brand films, interviews, and podcast episodes, typically 3–15 minutes. Real narrative arcs. Pacing that breathes. Color that has a point of view. The kind of piece someone watches to the end and then sends to a friend.



Short-form commercial.15–60 second vertical ads and social cuts for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. Same taste, compressed. Multiple hooks off the same footage, built to perform, not just to look good.



Most editors are good at one of these. We're looking for the one who can switch between them in the same afternoon.



This isn't a "YouTube editor" role. It's closer to a cinematographer's editor and post-production lead: someone whose taste becomes Tulen's standard.



---



What you'd actually be doing



- Turning raw vlog, venue, podcast, and interview footage into cinematic pieces with real story structure

- Cutting direct response ads and feed-native short-form, with multiple hook variations for testing

- Color correction and grading with an actual look, not a LUT and a prayer

- Clean dialogue, music mixing, sound design

- Titles, lower-thirds, captions, and motion graphics where they earn their place

- Pushing back on the brief when you see a better story in the footage

- Helping build Tulen's video workflows, standards, and eventually the team around them



---



Who this is for



- Taste first. Shot selection, story instincts, rhythm. We can't teach this, so it's the first thing we look for.

- 3–5+ years editing professionally, across both long-form and short-form.

- Advanced in Premiere Pro (DaVinci for color is a strong plus).

- Color and sound are part of the edit to you, not an afterthought.

- You know current Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube specs and why vertical pacing is different.

- Organized. Clean project files, version control, sane naming. We work out of Google Drive, ClickUp, and Slack.

- You communicate early. A blocker flagged on Monday is a non-issue. Flagged on Friday, it's a problem.



Bonus: wedding, hospitality, travel, or luxury brand work; direct response ad experience; commercial or film production background; motion graphics; captioning workflows.



---



What we don't care about



Your résumé, mostly. A flashy showreel, even less. Reels are the best 40 seconds of someone's career set to a drop.



We care how you think. Why you cut where you cut. What you left out. What inspires you. Who you learned to edit from. 



---



How this works



Step one is a paid test edit.Real footage, paid, five working days.



You get a raw podcast recording and b-roll across six environments. No script, no reference cut, no shot list. That's on purpose. We're not testing whether you can execute someone else's idea. We're testing your judgment.



Two cuts from the same footage:



1. A 30–45 second direct response ad, voiceover-driven.You build the VO from what the speaker actually said. You're selecting, not scripting: find the argument and cut the rest. Voice leads, picture follows.

2. A 15-second cut built for the feed. Not an ad. It has to stop a scroll with the sound off and get watched twice. Plus two alternate openings on the same body, so we can see how you think about hooks.



Both are held to a real craft spec: neutral, cinematic color that holds skin tones across every environment, sound design nobody notices, and clean captions.



What we're judging: clip selection, color consistency, whether you found something worth saying in the raw audio, restraint, and whether we're hooked in the first three seconds.



That's how we'll know. It's also how you'll know whether you actually want to work with us.



Turnaround once you're in: five business days for new projects, two for revisions, unless agreed otherwise.



On compensation: we're not posting a range. What you're worth depends on what you bring, and we'd rather stretch for the right person than save money on the wrong one. Tell us your number and we'll have a real conversation.



Logistics: fully remote, flexible schedule, with overlap for feedback and check-ins. Room to grow into creative leadership as the video side scales.



---



To apply



Email alek@tulenagency.com with the subject line:

[Your Full Name] | Senior Video Editor



Include:



- Your résumé (PDF)

- Portfolio links with both long-form and short-form work

- The three pieces that best represent you, and what exactly you did on each

- Your current employment or client commitments

- Your expected monthly rate

- A 1–3 minute Loom: why this role, and what you loved and hated about your last gig



Then answer these. There are a lot, and some won't look like they're about editing. That's on purpose.



1. Link the piece you're proudest of. What did the raw footage look like, and what's one choice in the edit that most editors wouldn't have made?

2. Link a piece you'd recut if you could. What would you change?

3. We hand you an hour of raw podcast audio and b-roll from six locations, and ask for a 30–45 second direct response ad at an A+ level. How long would that take you? Give us a number.

4. Why that number? Walk us through your process.

5. What's a video (not yours) you've watched more than five times? Why does it work?

6. How do you decide when to hold a shot versus cut?

7. A client's only note is "make it pop." What do you do?

8. Tell us about a workflow you simplified. What was broken, what did you change, what happened?

9. What important truth do very few people agree with you on?

10. What's one book or film that stuck with you this year, and why?

11. Are you delusional about what you can accomplish? Do you believe you can make anything put in front of you great?



Applications without a portfolio, résumé, and Loom won't be considered.



If you're a fit, we'll get on a call and you'll walk us through a timeline you've actually cut.



— Yewan, Tulen Agency

description:

JOB TITLE: INSTAGRAM DM SETTER (INBOUND)



WHAT IS THIS JOB? (READ THIS FIRST)



We are an education company. We teach people how to start an online drop shipping business.

THE WORK CULTURE



We work on common sense.



Nobody here will babysit you. We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen.

If you are sick, rest. We do not expect you to work sick. But if you are "sick" 3 days every week, we cannot keep working with you.

This is life-changing money. In exchange, you work hard. 12 hours a day, 7 days a week, from the comfort of your own home. No commute. No one watching your screen.



The more good calls you book, the more you make.

title: Real Estate Media Quality Control and Operations
description:
SnapHomes Media is a real estate photography company in Nashville, Tennessee. We shoot about 7-18 homes a week and we’re growing. I’m looking for a reliable, detail-oriented part-time assistant to quality check our edited photos and deliver them to agents the same day, so I can spend my time shooting and meeting new agents.



Hours and pay: Part-time, fixed monthly pay of $252, paid on the same date each month. Hours are flexible, usually 10-20 a week depending on how many shoots we have. You must be available for about 4 hours, 4 days a week, from roughly 5 PM to 9 PM US Central time (morning in the Philippines). Photos uploaded by 5 PM Central must be delivered by 9 PM Central the same day. Shoots finished after 5 PM are delivered the next morning. You’re free to take on other clients as long as this window is covered. A raise and more work are possible after a successful 3-month trial, and as we grow.

Upload new shoots to Fotello and download the edited photos.

Deliver finished photos to agents through our delivery platform on the same day and confirm they received them.

Follow up with agents after delivery, including asking for reviews, sending referral codes, and also handle
 marketing.

On slower days, research agents with active listings, keep lead lists, and track our offers in a spreadsheet.

title: Remote Engineering Support – CAD/BIM, Low Voltage & Fire Alarm Systems
description:
About Us

Industrial Electronic Systems, Inc. (IES) is a U.S.-based fire alarm and life safety systems company serving commercial customers in Northern California. We specialize in fire alarm design, installation, inspections, and low voltage systems integration.



About the Role

We are hiring a Remote Engineering Support specialist to help our U.S. engineering team design and document low voltage and fire alarm systems for commercial buildings. This is a hands-on engineering role — you'll model in BIM, draft in CAD, research code, and produce real deliverables for active construction projects.



We need someone who is:

• A strong CAD and BIM modeler (this is non-negotiable)

• Experienced with low voltage system design

• Comfortable with NFPA 72 / NEC code research (fire alarm experience is a big plus)

• A self-starter who can solve design challenges independently

• Detail-obsessed — drawings, layers, sheet sets, and revisions all done right

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities



CAD & BIM Engineering

• Produce 2D AutoCAD drawings — device layouts, risers, wiring diagrams, system details, and submittal sets.

• Build and maintain 3D BIM models (Revit / Navisworks) for low voltage and fire alarm systems.

• Set up sheets, viewports, title blocks, layers, and XREFs to company CAD standards.

• Coordinate clash detection and drawing updates with the broader project model.



Low Voltage & Fire Alarm Design Support

• Assist in designing NFPA-compliant fire alarm systems (device layout, spacing, placement).

• Support design of access control, intrusion, structured cabling, and other low voltage systems.

• Identify code-driven requirements — smoke/heat detector spacing, notification coverage, strobe candela placement, circuit routing and survivability.

• Review architectural and electrical drawings for design impact and coordination.



Research & Problem Solving

• Look up AHJ requirements (city/state fire department standards).

• Compare NFPA 72 / NEC requirements against local code amendments.

• Document findings and communicate design impacts to U.S. engineers.

• Identify missing information in plans and propose solutions before they become RFIs.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:

Presidential Group is a well-established and growing business group based in Perth, Western Australia, operating across multiple industries including construction, facilities management, cabinetry and joinery, and hospitality. We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager based in the Philippines to join our team on a full-time contractor basis, working directly with our Managing Director.

/Instagram), with a focus on performance and return on investment

GoHighLevel (GHL)



Minimum 2 years of hands-on GHL experience



Demonstrated proficiency in automation workflows, pipeline management, funnel builds, and CRM configuration



Portfolio or screenshots of GHL builds required with your application

Minimum 2 years managing Google Ads and/or Meta Ads campaigns



Must provide examples of campaigns managed, including budgets, results, and key metrics (ROAS, CPL, or equivalent)



Experience with Australian clients or markets is an advantage



Graphic Design



Proficient in Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)

Design portfolio required, including ad creatives, social media graphics, and brand assets



The Person We Are Looking For



Skills get you the interview. Personality gets you the role.



We have worked with remote team members before and we know the difference between someone who just completes tasks and someone who genuinely shows up for the team. We are looking for the latter.



You are the right person if you:



Take ownership without being asked. You do not wait to be told what needs doing. You see a gap, you fill it, and you report back.



Communicate proactively. If something is delayed, unclear, or going wrong, you say so early — not after the deadline has passed. No surprises.



Bring a positive attitude, consistently. Not just when things are easy. You stay solution-focused under pressure and do not let setbacks derail your output.



Are genuinely adaptable. We operate across multiple industries and brands. Priorities shift. You adjust without friction and without needing to be managed through it.



Have a growth mindset. You are curious, you stay across what is changing in digital marketing, and you bring ideas to the table rather than waiting to be directed.



Are honest and direct. We value straight communication. If you do not know something, say so. If you disagree, say so professionally. We would rather have that conversation than deal with avoidable mistakes.

Take pride in your work. Every asset you produce, every campaign you run, every report you send represents Presidential Group. You hold yourself to a high standard because you care about the outcome, not just the task.

This role is a long-term engagement for the right person. We pay well, we treat our team with respect, and we expect the same in return.



You Will Be a Strong Fit If You



Are based in the Philippines and available to start immediately

Bring a positive, can-do attitude and maintain it under pressure

Are highly adaptable and comfortable shifting priorities across multiple brands and industries

Work well independently, take full ownership of your output, and require minimal supervision

Communicate clearly and proactively in English

Are available during Perth business hours (AWST, UTC+8)

Have a reliable internet connection and your own equipment

Are comfortable using time-tracking software



What We Offer



Above-market remuneration: USD $1,500 – $2,500 per month, based on experience and demonstrated results

Immediate start for the right candidate

Full-time contractor engagement (Monday to Friday, Perth time)

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director

Stable, long-term engagement with a growing, multi-entity Australian business group

Consistent hours and reliable payment



How to Apply



We are moving quickly and will contact shortlisted candidates within 24 to 48 hours. Please include the following with your application:



Updated resume or CV

GHL portfolio — screenshots or recordings of automation builds, pipelines, or funnels

title: Student Accounts & Collections Officer
description:
Company: Alpha Technical Training

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote / Offshore

Industry: Vocational Education & Training (Australia)



ABOUT THE ROLE:



Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

- Ability to build rapport while maintaining a clear collection objective.

- Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving ability.

- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.

- Ability to work independently and achieve collection targets.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE:



- Experience collecting education or training fees.

- Experience working with Australian customers.

- Experience negotiating instalment arrangements.

- Familiarity with 
 or similar CRM platforms.

title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, or similar.

A strong ear for sound design and audio syncing.

Deep familiarity with current TikTok and Reels trends and humor formats.

Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with a US-based team.

Ability to manage a full weekly queue and meet turnaround times.



Nice to Have



Experience creating product videos for Amazon, Chewy, or TikTok Shop.

Experience editing paid social or Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. For each link, add one sentence naming the effect or technique you built, the software you used, and whether it shows beat-syncing or typography.
