title: Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a proactive and analytical Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager with hands-on construction industry experience, preferably in architectural sheet metal, aluminum composite material (ACM) panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope systems. The ideal candidate must have experience using Sage 300 CRE and Procore to monitor project costs, track field productivity, and evaluate financial performance.



This role combines construction cost engineering with project management support, focusing on cost control, labor productivity, cost-to-complete forecasting, and early identification of potential cost overruns. The ideal candidate understands construction operations, can interpret financial and field-production data, and proactively recommends corrective actions to protect project profitability.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor project budgets, actual costs, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and remaining costs for architectural sheet metal, ACM panel, exterior cladding, and building envelope projects.

* Reconcile Sage 300 CRE financial data with Procore daily reports, labor hours, installed quantities, and project progress.

* Analyze labor productivity and compare actual performance against estimated production rates to identify inefficiencies.

* Prepare realistic cost-to-complete forecasts and flag projects trending over budget before substantial losses occur.

* Review field reports for extra work, scope changes, delays, and potential change orders; organize supporting documentation for project manager review.

* Assist with purchase orders, subcontract commitments, cost coding, project documentation, and other assistant project management duties.

* Provide concise morning summaries and weekly reports highlighting budget variances, productivity concerns, outstanding issues, potential change orders, and recommended corrective actions.

* Coordinate with accounting, project managers, and field teams to investigate discrepancies and obtain missing information.

Improve reporting through Excel, automation, and appropriate AI tools, verifying accuracy against source records.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Industrial Engineering required.

* Relevant experience in construction cost engineering, project controls, or subcontractor cost management.

* Direct experience with architectural sheet metal, ACM panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope construction strongly preferred.

* Hands-on proficiency in Sage 300 CRE, including job costing, purchase orders, commitments, and budget tracking.

* Hands-on proficiency in Procore, including daily reports, labor hours, project progress, documentation, and change orders.

* Strong understanding of construction installation methods, labor productivity, cost forecasting, and change-order documentation.

* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, and financial reconciliations.

* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, estimates, and scope documents; Bluebeam experience preferred.

* Proactive and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, ask informed questions, and recommend practical solutions independently.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Availability to work 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time.



****Applicants must clearly disclose if they lack experience with Sage 300 CRE or Procore. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment****



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Financial Operations Coordinator
description:
Financial Operations Coordinator (Part-Time)



Company: Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc.

Location: Remote

Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week



About Us



Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc. is an established and growing beauty company based in the United States, with multiple salon locations and plans for continued expansion.



We’re looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Financial Operations Coordinator to help us stay on top of our daily business finances, expenses, budgets, and financial records.



We already have an accountant and bookkeeper, so we’re not looking for someone to take over those responsibilities. Instead, we need someone who can help us stay organized between accounting periods, keep our financial information up to date, and make sure important details don’t get overlooked.



We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, and genuinely enjoys keeping things organized.



Key Responsibilities



Expense Tracking & Budget Management



* Review and organize daily business expenses and purchases.

* Ensure expenses are assigned to the correct business location and budget category.

* Update and maintain our budgets in Oliv.

* Monitor spending and identify when expenses are approaching or exceeding budget.

* Organize receipts, invoices, and supporting documentation.

* Follow up on missing information or transactions that need clarification.



Cash Flow & Financial Organization



* Help monitor available cash and upcoming financial obligations.

* Maintain a calendar of bills, recurring payments, and due dates.

* Track expected income and expenses to help us plan ahead.

* Identify potential cash-flow concerns and bring them to management’s attention.

* Keep financial information current so ownership can make informed decisions.



Sales & Reporting



* Review daily sales reports from our salon management software, Meevo.

* Help track sales, deposits, and expenses by business location.

* Identify discrepancies or missing financial information.

* Prepare simple daily and weekly financial summaries.

* Provide clear updates on spending, budgets, upcoming bills, and outstanding items.



Accounting Support & Communication



* Work alongside our existing bookkeeper and accounting team.

* Assist with reviewing and organizing transaction information in Xero.

* Make sure necessary receipts and supporting documents are available.

* Communicate with management when transactions require clarification.

* Follow up on outstanding financial items until they’re resolved.



Systems We Use



Our company currently uses:



* Oliv: Budgeting and cash-flow management

* Meevo: Salon management and sales reporting

* Xero: Accounting and financial records



Experience with Xero is strongly preferred. Experience with Oliv or Meevo is not required, but applicants must be comfortable learning new systems.



We prefer to work with our existing software rather than introduce additional platforms.



Qualifications



* At least 2 years of experience in financial administration, bookkeeping support, expense tracking, or a related position.

* Familiarity with budgeting, cash flow, and basic accounting principles.

* Experience using Xero is strongly preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial reports.

* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

* Ability to manage responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

* Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses is a plus.

* Experience working with multiple business locations is a plus.



The Person We’re Looking For



We value consistency, honesty, communication, and accountability.



We’re looking for someone who doesn’t need to be reminded constantly to complete recurring tasks. Someone who notices when something doesn’t look right, asks questions when needed, and follows through until the issue is resolved.



You don’t need to know everything on your first day. We’re happy to explain our processes and help you become familiar with our business. What matters most is your willingness to learn, attention to detail, and ability to take ownership of your work.



Schedule & Opportunity



This is a long-term, part-time position starting at approximately 15 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours as our business grows.



The schedule offers some flexibility, but you should be available for occasional communication during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



How to Apply



If you’re interested in joining our team, please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your experience with Xero, expense tracking, budgeting, or cash-flow management.

3. Any experience you’ve had working with U.S.-based businesses.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD and weekly availability.

5. An example of how you’ve helped a previous employer stay financially organized.



Please begin your application with “Plush Rose Financial Coordinator” so we know you’ve read the full job description.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a short, paid skills assessment.



We’re looking forward to finding someone dependable who can grow with our company and become a valued part of our team.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for Clinics (English) | 800 USD/month + Bonus
description:
Hi! I'm William, founder of VisualFlow, a software company based in Miami. We build small clinics a website with online booking and a simple system that keeps track of every client and follows up for them. We're growing fast, and I'm looking for the first cold caller who grows with us.



I want a machine on the phone 💪 Someone with real energy, who loves talking to people, doesn't get shaken by a "no", and gets excited when the calendar fills up. If you've ever finished a shift and thought "I could have booked more," this is for you.



THE JOB

You call clinic owners and book them into a 15-minute call with me. You don't sell and you never quote prices. You start a real conversation, find out how new clients book with them, and book the call. I take it from there.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make 150 to 200 calls a day from our CRM dialer, with a script I give you and train you on personally

- Read the short note we prepare on each clinic before you dial

- Have short, friendly, confident conversations with clinic owners

- Book interested owners into my calendar

- Log every call and note in the CRM

- A 10-minute check-in every day in week 1, then one 30-minute call a week where we listen to your calls and level you up



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Great energy. People can hear your smile on the phone.

- Clear, confident, natural English. Non-negotiable.

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience, ideally calling North American businesses

- Hungry to grow, and you take feedback and use it the same day

- Quiet room, good headset, stable internet, backup power

- Available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (night shift in the Philippines)



PAY AND GROWTH

- 800 USD per month, paid weekly every Friday (about 185 USD per week)

- 10 USD bonus for every booked call that shows up, no cap

- 50 USD bonus for every clinic that becomes a client from your calls, no cap

- If you perform, your pay goes up as the results come in

- The best performer becomes the one who trains the next callers



HOW THE FIRST MONTH WORKS

The first month is a paid trial. You're paid every Friday for that week's hours. Every Friday we review your numbers and calls together, and either of us can end it at the end of any week. Hit the targets and the role becomes permanent after the first month, with a raise.



WHY JOIN US

We're a small, hungry team that moves fast. No corporate layers, you work directly with the founder, and your results are seen every single week. If you want to grow with a company that's just getting started, this is the seat.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Record a short video (Loom, or a Google Drive link), face on camera, max 90 seconds:

   - First, read this as if you were on a real call: "Hi, is this Sarah? Hi Sarah, this is [your name] from VisualFlow. I'll be quick, I know you're between clients. I tried to book with you online last night and couldn't find a way to do it. Can I ask, when someone finds you on Google at 9pm, how do they usually book with you?"

   - Then, in your own words and without a script, tell me about the best appointment you ever booked on a cold call.

2. In 3 lines, tell me your cold calling experience: who you called, how many calls a day, and what you booked.

3. Start your application with the word CLINIC so I know you read this far.



Applications without a video won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants do a live 10-minute role-play call with me, camera on. Can't wait to meet you!

title: Real Estate Photo QC & Client Support Assistant (Full-Time, US Night Shift)
description:
Department: Quality Control, Delivery & Operations

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 2:00 PM Arizona Time (10:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine Time), plus a short Saturday delivery shift from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM Arizona Time (10:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time), 37 hours per week. Arizona does not observe daylight saving time, so this schedule never shifts in Philippine Time. Your hours stay the same all year.

Compensation: $4 USD/hour (about $640 USD/month) during the first 30 days of paid training; $5 USD/hour (about $800 USD/month) after successful training. Paid weekly through Wise, with opportunities for performance bonuses, raises, and long-term growth.

Paid Time Off: 6 paid holidays per year (Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve, New Year's Day, Good Friday, and All Saints' Day/Undas), plus 5 paid days off per year after your first 90 days, scheduled with at least 2 weeks' notice.

Location: Remote / Work from Home

Type: Long-Term, Full-Time

Company: Alpine Property Media

About Alpine Property Media

Alpine Property Media is a growing, founder-led real estate media company serving Flagstaff, Sedona, and the Verde Valley in northern Arizona. We create listing photography, cinematic listing video, drone photo and video, floor plans, Zillow 3D tours, virtual twilight photos, and social media reels that help real estate agents market their listings with confidence. We promise next-morning delivery, so photos from each shoot reach the client the following morning, Arizona Time. Our goal is simple: make every listing worth stopping for.

We are a small company entering our next stage of growth, and this will be our first operations hire. You will work directly with Joel, the founder and lead photographer, to protect the quality of our work, simplify the client experience, and build repeatable systems as the company grows.

Our values guide how we work:

• Creative Excellence: We care about the details and take pride in work that feels intentional.

• Ownership: We follow through, communicate early, and do not wait for someone else to solve a problem.

• Consistency: Clients should receive the same high standard every time.

• Trust: We are honest, dependable, and careful with client work.

• Leadership: We look for solutions, improve systems, and help the people around us succeed.

• Freedom: We build systems that create more freedom for our clients, our team, and the company.

The Role

Your first responsibilities will be quality control and media delivery, covering client phone calls, texts, and
s during your shift, and handling booking and order changes in Spiro. We are not hiring someone to do everything on day one. You will first learn our standards, our services, and our delivery process. Once you can consistently protect the client experience without constant supervision, you will gradually take on calendar management, project coordination, outreach support, and other administrative responsibilities.

This role is for someone who wants to become a trusted long-term teammate, not someone looking for random tasks or short-term freelance work.

What You'll Own First

Quality Control & Media Delivery

• Review real estate photo galleries, videos, floor plans, 3D tours, and supporting assets against our QC checklists before anything reaches a client.

• Catch issues with color, exposure, straight verticals, window views, crops, reflections, object removal, branding, file order, links, and missing deliverables.

• Re-edit photos in AutoHDR when needed, including virtual twilights, map pins, and lot lines.

• Review finished listing videos from our video editor and send clear revision notes when an edit needs to be redone.

• Confirm that every client receives the correct package, files, links, permissions, and delivery message.

• Download, upload, name, organize, and archive files across Google Drive, Dropbox, Spiro, and our delivery systems.

• Deliver completed media by 12:00 PM Arizona Time on weekdays, and alert Joel by 11:00 AM if any job is at risk of running late. On Saturdays, deliver Friday's jobs by the end of your shift and alert Joel right away if one won't make it.

• Track revision requests from start to finish so nothing gets lost or left incomplete.

Client Communication & Bookings

• Answer client phone calls, texts, and
s through Quo and Gmail during your shift, and route anything you can't resolve to Joel.

• Make booking and order changes in Spiro, including property details, access instructions, and service selections.

• Send clear confirmations, status updates, delivery follow-ups, and revision messages.

What We Expect You To Grow Into

Coordination & Records

• Manage the booking calendar and keep property information and deadlines organized.

• Coordinate with Joel and our video editor, consolidate revision notes, and keep projects moving.

• Keep client records, deadlines, and project details accurate and current in our CRM.

Social Media & Administrative Support

• Help organize and schedule social media content, Canva assets, testimonials, and finished project highlights.

• Support Instagram engagement and outreach using our relationship-first approach: personal, thoughtful, and never spammy.

• Turn voice notes, call summaries, and ideas into organized tasks, follow-ups, or CRM updates.

• Document repeatable processes and improve SOPs as you learn the role.

• Take on additional high-impact administrative work as trust, skill, and responsibility grow.

What Success Looks Like

• Media is delivered correctly, on time, and at the quality level promised to the client.

• Preventable mistakes are caught before a client sees them.

• Client calls, texts, and
s are answered promptly and professionally.

• Files, tasks, revision notes, calendars, and client records stay clean and current.

• Problems are communicated early with a proposed solution, not hidden until they become urgent.

• You become more independent over time and help make the process better, not just busier.

What We're Looking For

Required

• Strong written and spoken English, with a professional but friendly communication style, and comfort speaking with US clients by phone.

• Exceptional attention to detail and the patience to review creative work carefully.

• Dependability during the stated Arizona Time schedule. Morning delivery coverage is a core part of this role.

• A stable internet connection with at least 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, plus a backup plan for power or internet outages.

• A reliable computer capable of reviewing high-resolution photos and video. Windows is required because IrfanView, one of the photo tools in our workflow, only runs on Windows.

• Comfort using Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, cloud storage, and task-management systems.

• The ability to follow a checklist, take useful notes, ask questions early, and accept direct feedback without becoming defensive.

• A proactive mindset: if you notice a mistake, delay, or unclear instruction, you speak up and help solve it.

Preferred Experience

• Photo editing experience, especially AutoHDR, Lightroom, Photoshop, or real estate photo editing such as virtual twilights, object removal, and color correction.

• Real estate media, photography, video production, creative quality control, or post-production.

• Client support by phone, scheduling, project coordination, or administrative operations.

• Spiro, Quo, Dropbox, CubiCasa, Imagen AI, Canva, or similar tools.

• Creating process documentation or helping a small business improve its systems.

What It's Like to Work With Me

I'm Joel, and I founded Alpine Property Media. I'm creative, relationship-driven, and deeply invested in the client experience. I move quickly, manage multiple projects, and care about doing work the right way. I will give you training, checklists, examples, and direct feedback. I don't expect you to know everything on day one, but I do expect you to take notes, communicate honestly, and improve with repetition.

This is still a growing small business, so some systems are being built as we go. If you need a perfectly finished corporate environment with every answer already written down, this will not be the right fit. If you enjoy creating order, improving processes, and growing with a company from an early stage, you may thrive here.

Why Join Alpine Property Media

• Become the first operations teammate and make a visible impact on how the company grows.

• Work directly with the founder and learn the real estate media business from the inside.

• Do creative, meaningful work for real estate agents and the homes they represent.

• Enjoy a stable schedule that never changes with daylight saving time.

• Receive structured training, regular feedback, weekly pay, paid holidays and time off, and opportunities to earn more responsibility.

• Grow toward a future Operations Lead or VA Team Lead position as the company adds more team members.

How to Apply

Apply by
. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.

 your complete application to: 

Use this exact subject line:

APM QC Assistant, [Your Full Name]

Your
 must include:

1. Your current resume in PDF format.

3. A Google Drive link to a 2 to 5 minute unedited video introduction in English with your face visible. Set the sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" so we can open it.

In the video, answer these questions:

Our Hiring Process

 application. Send your resume, speed test, and video introduction as described above.

title: Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist
description:
About Apex Operations



Apex Operations is a growing marketing agency that helps contractors and home-service businesses generate leads, strengthen their brands, and scale their companies through websites, paid advertising, SEO, content, and business systems.



As the company grows, we are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist to help us maintain accurate financial records, improve financial visibility, and give leadership a clearer understanding of where money is coming from, where it is going, and how the business is performing.



Position Overview



The Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist will be responsible for keeping our QuickBooks account accurate and up to date, categorizing income and expenses, reconciling accounts, tracking commissions, and producing regular financial and operational reports.



This person will also help separate and properly document personal versus business expenses, identify unnecessary or duplicate spending, monitor recurring subscriptions, and provide leadership with clear financial insights.



This is not strictly a data-entry bookkeeping role. We need someone who can maintain the numbers while also helping us understand what those numbers mean.



Primary Responsibilities

QuickBooks and Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate and current records in QuickBooks Online.

Categorize income, expenses, transfers, owner distributions, and reimbursements.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and other financial accounts.

Review transactions for missing information, incorrect classifications, or duplicate entries.

Maintain an organized chart of accounts that reflects the way Apex Operations operates.

Ensure revenue is properly recorded by client, service, or revenue category when applicable.

Keep supporting documentation, receipts, invoices, and financial records organized.

Coordinate with the company’s CPA or tax professional when necessary.

Business and Personal Expense Tracking

Help identify and separate business expenses from personal expenses.

Track owner contributions, reimbursements, distributions, and personal purchases made through business accounts.

Flag expenses that require clarification before categorizing them.

Create a clear process for documenting expenses and submitting receipts.

Help leadership understand how personal transactions affect the company’s books and financial reports.

Accounts Payable and Expense Management

Track bills, contractor payments, software subscriptions, vendor expenses, and other outgoing payments.

Maintain a schedule of recurring business expenses.

Identify duplicate subscriptions, unnecessary expenses, unexpected increases, and potential cost-saving opportunities.

Provide visibility into upcoming bills and cash obligations.

Verify that contractors, vendors, and team members are being paid accurately.

Commission and Compensation Tracking

Calculate and track commissions owed to sales representatives, appointment setters, account managers, or other team members.

Maintain accurate commission records based on collected revenue, payment terms, and company compensation agreements.

Prepare commission payout reports for leadership approval.

Track commissions that are earned, pending, paid, adjusted, or clawed back.

Reconcile commission payouts against client payments and company records.

Help develop a consistent and transparent commission tracking system.

Financial Reporting and Business Analytics

Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports for leadership.

Produce and explain reports such as:

Profit and loss statements

Cash flow summaries

Revenue by client

Revenue by service

Monthly recurring revenue

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Contractor and payroll expenses

Software and subscription expenses

Commission obligations

Client acquisition costs

Gross profit and net profit

Department or service-line profitability

Compare financial results against previous months, targets, or budgets.

Identify unusual spending, declining margins, missed payments, or financial risks.

Translate financial information into clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Help create dashboards or scorecards that make the company’s financial performance easy to understand.

Client Payment and Revenue Tracking

Track invoices, recurring payments, overdue balances, failed payments, refunds, and payment plans.

Confirm that client payments match contracts, invoices, and internal records.

Maintain accurate accounts receivable reports.

Flag overdue or failed payments for the appropriate team member to follow up on.

Help leadership forecast expected cash collections.

Financial Processes and Controls

Develop and document standard operating procedures for bookkeeping, expenses, commissions, reimbursements, and financial reporting.

Improve the accuracy and consistency of financial information across the company.

Establish recurring weekly and monthly financial review processes.

Help reduce financial errors, missing documentation, and inconsistent reporting.

Protect confidential company, client, employee, and financial information.

Expected Reporting



The Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist should be prepared to deliver:



Weekly Reports

Current cash position

Payments received

Outstanding client balances

Upcoming bills and payouts

Commissions owed

Unusual or uncategorized transactions

Major financial issues requiring leadership attention

Monthly Reports

Profit and loss statement

Revenue breakdown

Expense breakdown

Cash flow summary

Gross and net profit

Commission payout report

Accounts receivable report

Recurring subscription report

Month-over-month performance comparison

Key financial observations and recommendations

Qualifications

Proven experience with bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial reporting.

Strong experience with QuickBooks Online.

Experience reconciling bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors.

Strong understanding of income statements, cash flow, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and expense categorization.

Experience calculating commissions, bonuses, or variable compensation.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and financial summaries.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to identify inconsistencies and ask the right questions.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage confidential financial information responsibly.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to explain financial information in simple, practical language.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with a marketing agency, service business, contractor, or remote team.

Experience with Stripe and other recurring payment platforms.

Experience tracking revenue and profitability by client or service.

Experience working with commissioned sales teams.

Experience building financial dashboards and operational scorecards.

Familiarity with payroll, contractor payments, budgeting, and cash-flow forecasting.

Experience coordinating with CPAs, tax preparers, or outsourced accounting firms.

AI tools that can be used to add efficiency to the job role.



What Success Looks Like



The right person will create a financial system where:



QuickBooks is consistently accurate and up to date.

Leadership knows how much money the company has, owes, and expects to collect.

Personal and business transactions are clearly separated and documented.

Commission payouts are calculated accurately and on time.

Client payments and outstanding balances are easy to track.

Financial reports are delivered consistently.

Unnecessary expenses and financial issues are identified early.

Leadership can make decisions based on reliable financial information.

The company has a clear understanding of profitability by client, service, and business area.

Key Performance Indicators



Performance may be measured by:



Monthly reconciliations completed on time.

Percentage of transactions properly categorized.

Number of unresolved or uncategorized transactions.

Accuracy of commission calculations.

The Opportunity

About the Role



We are seeking a technically capable, proactive, and commercially minded Shopify, AI & Digital Technology Specialist to support and scale a global luxury fashion e-commerce business.



This role combines Shopify development, AI implementation, software integrations, workflow automation, and digital operations. The successful candidate will use technology to improve the online customer experience, streamline operations, increase productivity, and support profitable international growth.



We are looking for someone who can do more than use AI tools. You should be comfortable working with code, APIs, automation platforms, and digital systems to build practical solutions that deliver measurable results. A team player ready to integrate into a high energy and productive team.

Qualifications & Experience



Essential

 marketing, and analytics integrations.

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager 



Company: Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc.

Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Location: Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $6.50 USD per hour

Schedule: Approximately 15–20 hours per week



About Us



Plush Rose a Blowout Bar Salon Inc. is a growing U.S.-based salon company with locations in Georgia and Missouri. We are a small, team-based organization focused on providing excellent service while building a strong, organized business.



We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager who can take ownership of our human resources operations, improve existing processes, and help establish consistent policies and procedures across our locations.



We already have systems in place, but we recognize opportunities to improve organization, communication, and efficiency.



We need someone who brings experience, takes initiative, identifies problems, and recommends solutions without needing constant direction.



Our goal is to build a professional, well-organized HR department that can support our current employees and future growth.



Key Responsibilities



HR Administration & Employee Records



* Maintain accurate, confidential, and organized employee personnel files and documentation.

* Track employment agreements, certifications, policy acknowledgments, and important HR deadlines.

* Establish consistent digital recordkeeping procedures across locations.

* Review current HR systems, identify gaps, and recommend improvements.



Attendance, Scheduling & Employee Communication



* Develop clear procedures for attendance, punctuality, call-outs, schedule changes, and time-off requests.

* Track attendance concerns and maintain appropriate documentation.

* Manage time-off policies, balances, accruals, and approval workflows within Gusto.

* Establish clear communication procedures between employees, salon managers, and HR.

* Ensure employees report immediate staffing concerns to their on-site manager, with appropriate follow-up and documentation through HR.

* Serve as the primary contact for routine HR questions, employee concerns, and policy clarification.

* Provide regular updates to ownership while escalating matters requiring management decisions.



Gusto & Payroll Administration



* Assist with payroll preparation and review through Gusto.

* Verify employee hours, time-off entries, pay adjustments, and payroll changes.

* Identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections before payroll processing.

* Review our current Gusto setup and recommend improvements.

* Help streamline payroll preparation, onboarding, employee records, and time-off administration.

* Coordinate with salon management to ensure timely and accurate payroll information.



Final payroll approval will remain with the business owner.



Recruitment, Onboarding & Employee Relations



* Assist with job postings, applicant screening, and interview coordination.

* Develop consistent hiring, onboarding, and offboarding procedures.

* Maintain onboarding checklists, employee orientation materials, and required employment documents.

* Coordinate employment eligibility verification and new-hire documentation with authorized U.S.-based personnel.

* Establish structured employee performance review processes and evaluation templates.

* Support salon managers with employee coaching, corrective actions, and performance improvement documentation.

* Help address employee concerns professionally while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.



Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) & Process Improvement



* Develop, organize, and maintain professional SOPs for HR and employee-related processes.

* Review existing policies, procedures, and company documents to identify opportunities for improvement.

* Create standardized forms, checklists, templates, and workflows for hiring, onboarding, payroll, attendance, and performance management.

* Work with salon management to document operational procedures, including opening and closing responsibilities and employee expectations.

* Establish a centralized, easy-to-maintain digital SOP system.

* Help managers implement new procedures consistently across locations.

* Create systems that can be easily introduced as the company expands.



HR Policies & Compliance



* Review and help maintain the employee handbook and company HR policies.

* Recommend improvements to attendance, leave, scheduling, employee conduct, and performance policies.

* Help coordinate HR practices in accordance with applicable U.S. federal, Georgia, and Missouri employment requirements.

* Identify potential compliance concerns and recommend appropriate professional guidance when needed.

* Support consistent HR procedures while recognizing location-specific requirements.



Qualifications



* Minimum of 5 years of professional HR experience, preferably as an HR Manager, Senior HR Generalist, or similar role.

* Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses and employees is required.

* Hands-on experience with Gusto is strongly preferred.

* Strong knowledge of payroll administration, onboarding, employee records, attendance management, and employee relations.

* Proven experience developing or improving HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and internal workflows.

* Experience supporting small or growing businesses is highly preferred.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.

* Comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and offering professional recommendations.

* Proficient with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and digital documentation.

* Experience supporting multiple business locations is a plus.

* Familiarity with U.S. government contract employment requirements is an advantage but not required.



Who We’re Looking For



We want someone who genuinely enjoys creating structure, solving problems, and helping businesses operate more efficiently.



The ideal candidate is experienced, dependable, proactive, and confident enough to make recommendations rather than simply wait for instructions.



You should be comfortable evaluating existing processes, explaining what needs improvement, and taking responsibility for implementing those improvements.



We value someone who can work independently while maintaining professional communication with ownership and salon management.



Schedule & Compensation



* Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week initially.

* $6.50 USD per hour.

* Long-term opportunity with potential for additional hours as the company grows.

* Some availability during U.S. Eastern or Central business hours is required.

* Flexible scheduling outside required coordination hours.



Initially, the focus will be on organizing employee records, improving communication procedures, reviewing Gusto and HR policies, and developing essential SOPs. Additional responsibilities will transition into the role as systems become established.



How to Apply



Please provide the following information:



1. A summary of your HR experience, including how many years you have supported U.S.-based companies.

2. Your experience using Gusto and the specific HR or payroll functions you have managed.

3. Examples of SOPs, employee handbooks, onboarding systems, or HR processes you have personally developed or improved.

4. Your experience managing attendance, time-off requests, payroll administration, and employee performance.

5. Your experience working with small businesses or multiple locations.

6. Your availability during U.S. business hours and confirmation that the advertised hourly rate works for you.



We are looking for an experienced HR professional who can help us organize, improve, and manage our HR operations—not someone who is learning human resources for the first time.



If you enjoy taking ownership, improving systems, and helping a growing business operate more efficiently, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Technical Business Analyst & Product QA Lead – SaaS / CRM
description:
Technical Business Analyst & Product QA Lead – SaaS / CRM



Remote | Philippines | Full-time preferred



We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product QA Lead to help complete and improve an existing business management software platform.



The platform supports workflows such as customer management, quoting, job management, scheduling, invoicing, inventory and accounting integrations.



You will work directly with the product owner and lead developer to understand how the system should work, identify gaps, document clear business rules and thoroughly test completed changes.



We need someone who can take a discussion, recording or rough explanation and turn it into clear requirements that developers can implement and testers can verify. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying missing scenarios and following issues through to resolution.



Your responsibilities will include:



Review the existing application and understand its workflows, users and business processes.



Work with the product owner to define intended behaviour and resolve unclear or conflicting requirements.



Map workflows and document business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.



Identify missing steps, confusing interfaces, inconsistent behaviour and opportunities to simplify workflows.



Create clear GitHub issues containing the problem, reproduction steps, expected and actual results, supporting screenshots or recordings, and acceptance criteria.



Distinguish bugs from new feature requests and decisions that need product-owner approval.



Perform hands-on testing across complete workflows, including normal use, unusual scenarios, errors and permissions.



Verify fixes and perform regression testing to check that existing functionality still works.



Help maintain an organised backlog, prioritise launch blockers and communicate progress clearly.



Keep workflow documentation and test cases aligned with approved changes.



Coordinate with developers and testers so that work is only marked complete once the agreed requirements have been verified.



Accounting and integration experience would be particularly valuable. Where applicable, you will help check that information moving between our platform and Xero is accurate and consistent, including customers, invoices, taxes, payments and transaction statuses.



We are looking for someone with:



Proven experience in software business analysis, product analysis, hands-on QA or a closely related role.



Experience working with an existing SaaS, CRM, ERP or business management platform.



Strong ability to turn business requirements into practical workflows and testable acceptance criteria.



Experience investigating issues and writing clear, actionable reports for developers.



Strong understanding of end-to-end testing, edge cases and regression testing.



Familiarity with GitHub Issues, Jira or a similar issue-management system.



Clear written and spoken English.



Strong attention to detail, logical thinking and the ability to work independently.



Confidence raising concerns when requirements are unclear or completed work does not meet the agreed behaviour.



Useful additional experience includes:



Xero usage, implementation or integration testing.



Trade services, field service, construction, job management or inventory software.



Invoicing, purchasing, bookkeeping and tax-related workflows.



API testing with Postman, reading JSON, browser developer tools or basic SQL.



Playwright or other automated testing tools.



Figma, wireframes or workflow diagrams.



A development background that helps you investigate issues and collaborate with engineers.



Programming is not the main responsibility of this role. Initial work will use the test application, documentation and issue tracker; access to the application’s source code is not required.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who will actively use the system, understand the business logic, find problems, propose practical improvements and verify the results.



Pay is negotiable based on experience. Please include your expected hourly rate and currency.



Please also provide your weekly availability, preferred working hours, timezone and earliest start date. Agreed daily overlap with the product owner and development team will be required.



Time-tracking software will be used during the initial engagement.



To apply, please submit:



Your CV and a short summary of your relevant business analysis and QA experience.



Details of any CRM, SaaS, trade services or business management platforms you have worked on, explaining your responsibilities.



Your experience with Xero or other accounting integrations.



An anonymised example of a workflow, business requirement or user story with acceptance criteria.



An example of a clear bug report you have written, including how you verified the fix.



Your expected hourly rate and currency, availability and earliest start date.



Please also briefly describe a time you identified a workflow or business-rule problem that others had missed, and how you helped resolve it.



Please use “Technical BA & Product QA Lead” as your application subject.

title: Experienced U.S. Insurance Customer Service and Claims Specialist
description:
Experienced U.S. Insurance Customer Service and Claims Specialist



Remote, Philippines | Independent Contractor

Compensation: $900 to $1,300 USD per month

Experience with U.S. insurance is REQUIRED. This is not an entry level role.



ABOUT SHORE LEGACY INSURANCE

Shore Legacy Insurance is a growing, family owned American insurance agency. We offer supplemental health insurance, home health care benefits, hospital indemnity, cancer, dental and vision plans, Medicare, and life insurance.



Many of our clients are American seniors who count on us to help them understand their benefits and fix problems. We need someone who knows how to get things done, follows through without being reminded, and genuinely enjoys helping people.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Claims Assistance: Help clients complete and submit claim forms, identify missing documents, and follow up with the carrier until a decision is made.

- Carrier Communication: Contact U.S. insurance carriers by phone,
, and portal to investigate claims, resolve open issues, and get answers.

- NSF and Billing Recovery: Work returned premium drafts (NSF), failed payments, and billing problems. Contact clients to correct payment information and help prevent lapses and cancellations.

- Policy Servicing: Process address changes, payment updates, and requests for policy documents. Answer general service questions and route coverage or plan questions to a licensed agent.

- Client Support: Speak directly with American clients by phone and text, including seniors who need extra patience.

- Follow Through: Track every open issue, keep organized records, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Systems: Use carrier portals, our CRM, and call recording tools to manage client accounts.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 2 years supporting a U.S. insurance agency, carrier, or insurance BPO

- Hands on experience with claims, policy servicing, billing or NSF recovery, or carrier communications

- Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, professional phone manner

- Strong problem solving and the ability to work independently

- Excellent attention to detail and organization

- Experience with CRM systems and insurance carrier portals

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a professional home office setup



ESPECIALLY VALUABLE

- Experience with supplemental health, hospital indemnity, home health care, Medicare, or life insurance

- Experience with GoHighLevel, EnrollHere, or similar CRM and call recording platforms

- HIPAA training or experience handling protected health information



COMPENSATION AND WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Monthly contract fee: $900 to $1,300 USD, depending on experience

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Engagement: Independent contractor

- Availability: About 40 hours per week, with coverage periods agreed together between 9 AM and 9 PM U.S. Eastern Time (night shift Philippine time)

- A signed confidentiality agreement is required, since this role involves client health and financial information



We are looking for a long term working relationship with our growing agency.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Claims Specialist - [Your Name]" and include:

1. Your résumé, including your U.S. insurance experience

2. The names of the U.S. insurance agencies, carriers, or BPOs you have supported

3. The types of insurance and the carrier portals you have worked with

4. A 60 second voice recording introducing yourself and your insurance experience

5. A short answer in your own words: A 78 year old client calls upset because her premium payment was returned and she is afraid of losing her policy. What do you do?



Applications missing any item will not be reviewed. We prioritize applicants with verifiable U.S. insurance experience and strong phone skills.



Shore Legacy Insurance, LLC

title: Healthcare VA -- Dermatology Prior Authorizations, Accutane/iPledge & Pathology Results
description:
TYPE / HOURS: Full-time. Must work US Eastern business hours (approx. 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM ET) -- you'll be on the phone/portals with US insurers and pharmacies during their business hours. This is an evening/overnight shift in the Philippines; please only apply if that works for you long-term.



ABOUT US:

We're a growing dermatology practice in South Florida. We need a specialist who already knows three specific derm-office workflows cold:

1. Prior authorizations -- getting biologics, topicals, and other meds approved with insurance (CoverMyMeds, payer portals, appeals on denials).

2. Accutane / isotretinoin (iPledge REMS) -- tracking monthly labs and pregnancy-test windows, entering/confirming patients in the iPledge system, coordinating with pharmacies so prescriptions are only released when a patient is actually compliant. This is federally regulated and our prescriber is personally liable for it -- there is zero room for shortcuts.

3. Pathology / biopsy result tracking -- making sure every biopsy gets a result, every patient with a result gets contacted per protocol, and anything urgent (e.g., melanoma) is flagged to the provider immediately, not sat on.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Submit and follow up on prior authorizations; work denials and appeals to resolution.

- Run the iPledge/Accutane compliance checklist for every isotretinoin patient -- labs current, pregnancy test in window, confirmation entered -- before any prescription is released.

- Track pathology results against every biopsy performed; log results, contact patients per protocol, and escalate anything urgent to the provider the same day.

- Coordinate with pharmacies and insurers by phone and message.

- Document everything accurately; keep all patient information strictly confidential.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR (THIS MATTERS MOST):

- Real, hands-on derm-office experience in all three lanes above -- prior auths, Accutane/iPledge, and pathology/biopsy tracking. Tell us the systems you've used (iPledge, CoverMyMeds, EMA/ModMed, or similar) and give specific examples. General VA or unrelated medical-admin experience does not meet this bar -- please don't apply without this specific background.

- Common sense, maturity, and the ability to work independently -- you catch your own mistakes, you never guess on anything regulatory or clinical, and you escalate the right things immediately.

- Meticulous and deadline-driven -- a missed lab window or a sat-on path result is a real patient safety issue, not just an inconvenience.

- Excellent spoken and written English.



REQUIREMENTS: Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet place to take calls, a working headset.



TO APPLY: Start your message with the exact phrase "Let's get it cleared!" (this is how we know you read the whole post). Then (1) attach your CV/resume -- name the specific systems you've used for prior auths, iPledge/Accutane, and pathology tracking -- and (2) in 2-3 sentences, tell me about a time you caught a serious error on your own, with no one available to ask for help -- what happened and what you did. Applications that skip the phrase, the CV, or the specific systems won't be reviewed.

title: Property Accountant (RCG Portfolio)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Property Accountant to join our team supporting the RCG Portfolio. In this role, you will oversee multi-entity property accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and manage tenant billing operations across commercial and multi-family real estate assets.



Working directly with AV Leads and Property Managers, you will ensure total ledger accuracy, execute timely bank reconciliations, manage lease financials, and deliver thorough month-end reporting packages tailored to RCG’s operational standards.



Key Responsibilities:



Property Accounting & Bookkeeping: 

Maintain accurate general ledgers across assigned properties and corporate entities. Execute daily cash management, monitor account balances, perform multi-account bank reconciliations, process AP/AR transactions, and drive month-end and year-end close routines (journal entries, accruals, prepaid schedules).



Tenant Management & Revenue Recovery: 

Oversee complex tenant recovery operations, including calculating and billing Common Area Maintenance (CAM), real estate tax reimbursements, and insurance/utility pass-throughs. Track security deposits, manage lease renewals, monitor delinquencies, and lead collection efforts.



Lease Financial Management & Abstracting: 

Review new and modified lease agreements to verify accounting system schedules against contractual terms. Maintain a centralized lease abstract database tracking key renewal dates, percentage rent clauses, CAM caps, and audit rights.



Portfolio Reporting & PM Support: 

Partner with Property and Asset Managers to deliver monthly financial reporting packages (Balance Sheets, Income Statements, Budget-vs.-Actual variance analyses), as well as compliance reports for lenders and investors.



Qualifications & Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Professional Experience: 3+ years in property accounting, real estate bookkeeping, or multi-entity financial management across commercial, retail, or multi-family real estate assets.



Software Proficiency: 

Hands-on experience with real estate accounting software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, or QuickBooks Online).



CAM & Tax Reconciliations: 

Proven expertise executing annual CAM, property tax, and insurance reconciliations for commercial tenants.

title: B2B Appointment Setter | Community Outreach & Events
description:
B2B Appointment Setter | Community Outreach & Events



Remote, Philippines | Part Time | Independent Contractor

Earn $350 to $500 USD per month plus $25 for every completed, qualified event. Strong performers can earn about $750 to $950 per month.



U.S. B2B appointment setting experience REQUIRED.



We are looking for an experienced appointment setter who can get our licensed insurance agents invited to speak at senior communities, community organizations, and local events throughout the United States. When outreach is slower, you will also help our agents stay connected with existing clients and schedule appointments.



This is not a consumer cold calling or insurance sales position. Your main job is to contact organizations, build relationships with decision makers, and arrange presentations and community events for our agents.



We value results, not just calls made or appointments entered into a calendar.



ABOUT SHORE LEGACY INSURANCE

Shore Legacy Insurance is a growing, family owned American insurance agency. We help seniors and families with supplemental health, home health care, hospital indemnity, and life insurance.



Our licensed agents give free presentations about planning for home health care costs, understanding supplemental insurance, protecting against insurance scams, and preparing for unexpected medical expenses. Our agents also participate in health fairs, senior expos, and community events.



We need someone who can open doors, build relationships, and fill their calendars.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Main Focus: Presentations and Events

- Book Speaking Engagements: Contact senior communities and other organizations to arrange free presentations by our licensed agents.

- Book Community Events: Find health fairs, senior expos, festivals, community fairs, church events, and other opportunities where our agents can attend, speak, or host a booth.

- Research Opportunities: Identify senior centers, retirement communities, 55+ communities, HOAs, churches, veterans organizations, civic clubs, libraries, and employers interested in lunch and learn sessions.

- Reach Decision Makers: Speak directly with activity directors, community managers, event coordinators, pastors, HOA board members, and HR managers.

- Build Relationships: Turn initial conversations into confirmed presentations and develop repeat invitations.

- Coordinate Events: Confirm dates, locations, expected attendance, presentation topics, and the host's rules, including what our agents may and may not do at the event. Any participation fees must be approved in advance.

- Follow Up: Confirm appointments, send reminders, and help ensure presentations and events actually happen.



Additional Duties: Client Engagement and Appointment Setting

- Client Check Ins: Contact existing clients by phone, text, and
 for welcome calls, annual review reminders, and general check ins.

- Event Invitations: Invite existing clients to upcoming presentations and events in their area.

- Appointment Setting: Schedule appointments with our licensed agents for existing clients and for people who have asked us to contact them.

- Referrals: Ask satisfied clients whether they know someone who might want information. You will not contact referred individuals unless they reach out to us or request contact themselves.



Your primary performance goal is booking completed presentations and community events. Client engagement duties are assigned when event outreach is slower.



Track Results: Maintain accurate records of calls, contacts, follow ups, bookings, and event outcomes in our CRM.



You will follow company approved scripts and procedures. You will only contact consumers who are existing clients or who have asked to be contacted. You will not discuss insurance plans, coverage, pricing, or recommendations. Our licensed agents handle insurance discussions and sales.



TARGET MARKETS

You will arrange presentations and events in U.S. communities where Shore Legacy Insurance has licensed agents available. We will provide the geographic areas to focus on and expand those markets as our agency grows.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 2 years of B2B appointment setting, outbound calling, or business development experience with U.S. companies

- Proven experience reaching American business owners, managers, or organizational decision makers and securing appointments

- Excellent spoken English and confident, professional telephone communication

- Comfortable contacting organizations that have never heard of our agency and persuading them to host a free presentation or welcome our agents to an event

- Comfortable with frequent outbound calling, voi
,
 outreach, and persistent follow up

- Warm, patient phone manner with older adults

- Able to overcome objections professionally without being pushy

- Strong organizational skills and experience using CRM systems

- Ability to research organizations, identify decision makers, and find contact information

- Reliable internet connection, backup connectivity, and a quiet home office

- Ability to work independently and consistently deliver results



Experience calling individual consumers alone is not sufficient. We need someone who knows how to reach business and organizational decision makers.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Experience arranging seminars, speaking engagements, community presentations, or vendor booths

- Experience with U.S. insurance, financial services, healthcare, or senior services businesses

- Experience with client retention or customer engagement calls

- Experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM software

- A demonstrated record of booking meetings that actually take place



Insurance experience is helpful but not required. We care most about your ability to develop relationships and secure real opportunities for our agents.



COMPENSATION AND WORK ARRANGEMENT

Monthly Contract Fee: $350 to $500 USD, depending on experience.



Performance Bonuses: Earn an additional $25 for every qualified presentation or approved community event that actually takes place.



Earning Potential: Strong performers who arrange about four completed, qualified events per week can earn about $750 to $950 per month, depending on their monthly contract fee. Actual earnings depend on results, and there is no cap on bonuses.



Bonus Qualifications:

- Presentations: Must be approved by Shore Legacy Insurance in advance, confirmed, completed, and meet the minimum attendance we set before booking.

- Community events (fairs, expos, festivals, and similar): Must be approved by Shore Legacy Insurance in advance as worth attending, and our agent must actually attend. Events we did not approve do not qualify.

- Canceled events do not qualify. Rescheduled events become eligible when completed and all requirements are met.



Location: Remote, Philippines

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Schedule: Part time, approximately 20 hours per week.



You set your own working hours within agreed U.S. business calling windows. Calls generally take place between 9 AM and 10 PM U.S. Eastern Time, depending on the market you are contacting. You are not expected to provide more than approximately 20 hours of service per week.



We are looking for an experienced, self directed professional who wants to build a long term relationship with our agency as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line: B2B Appointment Setter | Your Name



Please include:

1. Your résumé and a brief description of your U.S. appointment setting experience.

2. Previous experience: The U.S. companies or industries you have booked meetings or events for. Tell us whether you contacted businesses, organizations, or individual consumers.

3. Your results: Your typical weekly call volume, number of appointments booked, and how many of those appointments actually took place.

4. A 60 second voice recording: Demonstrate how you would introduce yourself to the activity director of a senior community and ask to schedule a free presentation.

5. A short written response: An activity director tells you, "We don't allow insurance salespeople here." What would you say next?



Applications missing any of these items will not be reviewed.



Selected applicants will complete a short live telephone roleplay.



Shore Legacy Insurance, LLC

title: Listing Quality & Launch Associate (Hostaway / Airbnb / VRBO / Booking)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Nomad Equity is a U.S.-based short-term rental management company managing 45+ vacation rental properties across Lake Tahoe, Southern California, Dallas, Oregon, and Hawaii. Hostaway is our system of record. It connects to Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking; PriceLabs drives our pricing; Monday tracks our work. When data drifts between these systems, guests see wrong information and we lose bookings.



We're hiring a Listing Quality & Launch Associate to own our listings from creation through ongoing accuracy. You will create new listings, publish them to every channel, and clear our Listing QA backlog, and you will find and fix the ROOT CAUSE of each mismatch (a mapping, a sync setting, a channel override) so it stops coming back.



This is not a generic VA role. It is a technical, detail-heavy role for someone who understands how Hostaway, Airbnb, VRBO, Booking, and PriceLabs pass data to each other.



---

LOCATION AND SCHEDULE



Remote. We are hiring from South America, Eastern Europe and the Philippines.

Full-time, Monday - Friday. Our team works 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Pacific Time, and you must overlap at least 4 hours every day with that window. Your remaining hours are flexible. This is a mostly asynchronous role: the 4-hour overlap is for live check-ins with the team, and the rest of the work is async and flexible.



---

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Launching new listings:

- Build new properties in Hostaway: details, bedrooms and beds, amenities, fees, taxes, house rules, photos, titles, and descriptions

- Create, connect, and publish listings on Airbnb, VRBO, Booking, and our direct booking site, and confirm each is live and matches Hostaway

- Set up PriceLabs mappings and base/min/max prices before a listing takes bookings

- Complete tax registration numbers, permits, and channel-specific requirements before go-live

- Run a standard go-live checklist on every new listing



Keeping listings accurate:

- Work our Listing QA board in Monday daily: investigate, fix, close with a note on what changed, escalate what you can't resolve

- Know which fields push from Hostaway to each channel, which can only be edited on the channel, and which get overwritten on the next sync; diagnose sync failures and delays

- Catch wrong or placeholder prices, and keep pet policies, cleaning fees, deposits, taxes, and house rules consistent on every channel

- Update guest FAQs and house guides when something changes on site

- Build checklists and templates so mistakes don't repeat; report weekly on open/closed items and recurring patterns



---

REQUIREMENTS (all required unless marked)



- 3+ years in short-term rental operations with deep, hands-on Hostaway experience (REQUIRED)

- Real PriceLabs experience, including how it connects to a PMS (REQUIRED)

- Expert-level Airbnb and VRBO host tools; working knowledge of the Booking extranet

- Experience building new listings from scratch on Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking and mapping them in a channel manager

- Hands-on use of Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools in your daily work (e.g., auditing listings, comparing data across systems, automating repetitive checks). Be ready to describe a real workflow.

- Proven ability to trace a data problem across systems and explain what caused it

- Very strong attention to detail and excellent written and spoken English (non-negotiable)

- Reliable high-speed internet, webcam, headset, and a quiet, professional workspace



Nice to have: Hostaway API / webhook / Zapier / Make experience; U.S. lodging-tax and STR permit knowledge; experience with portfolios of 50+ units; Spanish.



---

TOOLS YOU'LL USE DAILY

Hostaway, PriceLabs, Airbnb / VRBO / Booking host tools, Monday, Slack, Gmail, Claude



---

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- New listings go live on every channel correct on day one

- Listing QA backlog cleared, then kept near zero

- Each recurring mismatch gets a documented root cause and a permanent fix

- Zero placeholder or wrong prices sold



---

COMPENSATION

- Rate: $8-$15 USD per hour, depending on experience and English fluency

- Full-time, long-term engagement

- Payment: Bi-weekly (every two weeks), plus a Christmas bonus



---

HOW TO APPLY



1. Go to the link below, click "Apply now" on the Listing Quality & Launch Associate role, and complete our short AI voice-and-video interview (about 25-30 minutes, on a computer with camera and microphone, in a quiet place):


/careers

The interview is recorded in audio and video for our team to review.





We review every completed interview and respond to qualified applicants within 3 business days. Good luck!

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Company: Veterans Educating Veterans

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week

Position Summary

Veterans Educating Veterans is seeking an experienced and highly trustworthy Finance Manager to oversee the company’s financial operations.

This role will also be responsible for maintaining the financial records of a separate affiliated trust entity. The Finance Manager must keep both entities’ books, bank accounts, transactions, reports, and supporting documentation accurate, complete, and properly separated.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of independently managing financial reporting, budgeting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll coordination, reconciliations, collections, cash flow, and internal controls.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management

Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

Track revenue, expenses, cash flow, outstanding balances, and company performance.

Prepare budgets, forecasts, and budget-to-actual reports.

Identify discrepancies, financial risks, overspending, and cost-saving opportunities.

Provide clear financial updates and recommendations to the Chief Executive Officer.

Accounts Receivable and Collections

Manage invoicing, payment plans, recurring payments, and collections.

Monitor overdue accounts, failed payments, chargebacks, refunds, and payment disputes.

Reconcile client payments with banks, payment processors, accounting systems, and company records.

Maintain accurate aging and collections reports.

Accounts Payable and Expenses

Review and process vendor invoices, reimbursements, subscriptions, and company expenses.

Confirm that all expenses are properly approved and supported by documentation.

Prevent duplicate, inaccurate, or unauthorized payments.

Reconcile vendor statements, bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.

Review recurring expenses and recommend cost reductions.

Payroll and Contractor Payments

Coordinate payroll and contractor payments.

Verify salaries, hours, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, and adjustments.

Work with Human Resources on new hires, terminations, leave, compensation changes, and final payments.

Maintain accurate and confidential payroll and contractor records.

Trust Entity Responsibilities

Maintain separate accounting records for the trust entity.

Record and categorize trust income, expenses, contributions, transfers, and distributions.

Reconcile trust bank, investment, and payment accounts.

Prepare separate financial reports for the trust.

Maintain records for trustees, beneficiaries, vendors, assets, and distributions, as applicable.

Ensure trust funds are used only for authorized purposes.

Coordinate with trustees, accountants, tax professionals, attorneys, banks, and other authorized parties.

Organize documentation required for tax preparation, audits, legal review, or trust accounting.

Immediately report unauthorized activity, missing documentation, unusual transactions, or suspected misuse of funds.

Entity Separation and Controls

The Finance Manager must:

Maintain separate books, accounts, reports, and files for Veterans Educating Veterans and the trust entity.

Never combine or improperly transfer funds between the two entities.

Ensure payments and expenses are issued from the correct account.

Properly document all transactions between the entities.

Obtain written approval before processing transfers, refunds, distributions, or unusual payments.

Maintain a clear audit trail for all material transactions.

Protect all confidential company, client, employee, trustee, and beneficiary information.

Systems and Process Improvement

Maintain accurate records in Zoho Books and other approved financial systems.

Improve reporting, approval, reconciliation, and documentation processes.

Create and maintain finance-related standard operating procedures.

Recommend appropriate automation while preserving financial controls.

Train finance staff and other employees on required financial procedures.

Leadership and Accountability

Supervise finance or bookkeeping staff when applicable.

Assign tasks, review completed work, and enforce deadlines.

Work closely with Human Resources, Operations, Client Services, and leadership.

Present financial concerns together with recommended solutions.

Complete additional financial duties assigned by the Chief Executive Officer.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

At least five years of accounting or finance experience.

At least two years in a supervisory or finance-management role.

Strong experience with financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and reconciliations.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Experience with Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, or similar accounting software.

Strong attention to detail, integrity, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

Ability to manage the finances of multiple entities while maintaining proper separation.

Reliable internet connection and a professional remote workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CMA, or similar professional credential.

Experience with Zoho Books, Zoho CRM, or Zoho Analytics.

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company.

Experience with trust accounting, affiliated entities, or multiple related organizations.

Experience managing remote employees or international contractors.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be measured based on:

Accuracy and timeliness of reports.

Completion of reconciliations.

Accuracy of payroll and payments.

Collection performance.

Budget and cash-flow accuracy.

Proper separation of company and trust finances.

Quality of documentation and internal controls.

Responsiveness, reliability, and ability to meet deadlines.

This is a full-time salaried position. The salary is fixed and non-negotiable.

The salary covers all responsibilities related to Veterans Educating Veterans and the affiliated trust entity. Applicants should apply only if they accept the stated compensation.

Confidentiality and Authority

The Finance Manager will have access to sensitive company, banking, payroll, client, trust, trustee, and beneficiary information.

The Finance Manager may not transfer funds, issue unauthorized payments, change compensation, open or close accounts, make investment decisions, or disclose confidential information without proper authorization.

Any misuse of funds, unauthorized disclosure, fraud, or violation of financial procedures may result in immediate termination and possible legal action.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Veterans Educating Veterans is an equal opportunity organization. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, performance, integrity, and organizational needs without unlawful discrimination.
