title: Outbound Business Development Representative - Sell AI-Powered Websites to Nonprofits
description:
About us

Rayken Digital builds websites for nonprofits with AI built in. Our product, Rayken One, includes “Ask,” an AI tool that lets visitors type a question and get an answer pulled from the organization’s own reports, research, and documents. For a nonprofit sitting on years of publications nobody can find, that changes who uses their work. Ongoing hosting and maintenance is a separate monthly plan.



We’ve completed our first nonprofit project. Now we need someone to help us turn that into a repeatable pipeline.



The job: execute, then improve

We’ve done the groundwork. We need someone to put it to work and make it better.



What’s already built:



A list of about 700 environmental nonprofits in the eastern United States, all in the $500K–$3M revenue range

Each one checked for revenue, website, platform, how recently the site was updated, and other details

A ranked priority list, so you know where to start



1. Calling and booking meetings



Call down the list and reach the right person (usually the Executive Director, Communications Director, or Development Director)

Start conversations about how AI on their website could help them: making their research easy to find, answering the questions their staff answer every day, helping funders and members find what they need

Find out if there’s a real need and book meetings with qualified prospects for our founders

Follow up when it makes sense

Log every call and outcome in our Excel tracker



You will not be closing deals.



2. Improving the prospect list

Our list is a starting point, not a finished product. You’ll:



Fix bad data as you find it: wrong numbers, people who left, orgs that closed or merged

Find and add the right decision-maker names, titles, and contact info

Flag orgs that don’t fit and should come off the list.

Recommend which orgs should move up or down, based on what you hear on calls

Find new nonprofits that fit our target



3. Improving how we sell

Tell us what’s working and what isn’t, with the calls to back it up:



Which openings get real conversations

How prospects react to AI: interested, skeptical, confused

Which objections come up and what handles them

Which kinds of orgs are worth our time



If our list, script, or targeting is wrong, we want to hear it.



Who we’re looking for

You’ll be the first voice many US nonprofit leaders hear from us. These are executive directors who get a lot of calls and d
 in the first few seconds whether to keep listening. To earn that time, you need to sound like a natural, confident speaker of American English. That means:



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral American accent that US listeners understand easily

Natural, conversational phrasing, not scripted or formal

Comfort with American business norms: direct, friendly, and to the point



We will judge this from your interview or mock call recording, so please make sure it reflects how you’ll actually sound on the phone.



Requirements



3+ years of B2B cold calling or appointment setting, calling US businesses

Spoken English as described above

Able to work 9am–5pm US Eastern time (night shift in the Philippines)

Able to explain AI in plain language to a non-technical person

Comfortable keeping an Excel log accurate and up to date

Basic research skills: finding the right person at an organization using their website and LinkedIn

Reliable internet with a backup, quiet workspace, and a noise-canceling headset



Nice to have



Experience selling AI tools, software, or tech services

Experience calling nonprofits, associations, or schools

Experience cleaning or building prospect lists



How it works



Part-time, 15–20 hours per week to start, in set blocks during US Eastern business hours

Paid hourly for time worked

Two-week trial, then we d
 together whether to continue and whether to add hours

Short end-of-day report on days you work



How we’ll measure the work

Not just call counts. We’ll look at conversations with the right people, meetings booked and actually held, how much better the list gets, and useful feedback on what’s working.



To apply please answer:



How many cold calls do you make in a typical hour, and how often do you reach a decision-maker?



In two or three sentences, how would you explain the value of AI on a website to the director of a small environmental nonprofit who isn’t technical?



You spend two hours calling and barely reach anyone useful. How do you figure out whether the problem is the phone numbers, the time of day, the list, or your approach?



How do you find the right decision-maker at an organization when the website only lists a general info@
?



Attach or link a 1–2 minute recording of you doing a mock cold call to a US business (any industry is fine).

title: Part-Time E-commerce Listings & Systems Admin
description:
PART-TIME E-COMMERCE LISTINGS & SYSTEMS ADMIN

Catalog, Listings & Systems | Part-time, 10 to 20 hours a week | Remote (some overlap with US business hours) | Reports to Operations Lead



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell on our own Shopify site, Amazon, Nordstrom, Best Buy, Macy's, Belk, and Kohl's, and to corporate gifting buyers through ESP, SAGE, and rewards platforms like Stark. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.



THE ROLE

You'll own the accuracy of every product we sell, everywhere we sell it. One bag in one color lives on nine channels, each with its own template, rules, and error reports. You keep one master product sheet as the source of truth, push every launch, price change, and update out to every channel from it, and check each week that what's live matches what's true.



You'll also keep our systems in order: who has access to which tool, which subscriptions we pay for, and how each process is written down. This role is quiet, precise work. Nobody notices it when it's done right. Everybody notices a wrong price on Nordstrom.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Catalog and listings

1. Master product sheet: build and keep one source of truth for every SKU: UPC, dimensions, weight, materials, colors, image links, and units per master carton. Every channel template is filled from it. If a number isn't on file, you go get it from the right person. You never estimate it.

2. Launches and new colors: set up each new product on every channel from the master sheet, in each channel's template, and follow it through until it is live and correct.

3. Weekly listing health check: sweep every channel for suppressed or stranded Amazon listings, rejected marketplace uploads, retailer portal errors, broken variations, and feed errors. Fix what you can, escalate what you can't, and log both.

4. Price and promo updates: apply price and promo changes across every channel at once, and confirm no channel undercuts another or shows a price we didn't approve.

5. Corporate gifting and rewards catalogs (ESP, SAGE, Stark): keep quantity price breaks, imprint areas, decoration options, setup charges, and production times current and matched to the prices our sales team quotes. For Stark and our other rewards catalogs, maintain the Excel management file each partner receives: available-to-sell (ATS) quantity and image links for every SKU, checked against live stock and sent every month.

6. Images and UPCs: size and name images to each channel's specs, assign UPCs, and keep the UPC log.

7. Discontinued items: retire discontinued SKUs and colors on every channel, not just some.

8. Open tickets, followed until they clear: open cases with Amazon Seller Support, retailer portals, and marketplace support, and keep every open ticket in one log with its date opened, status, and next step. Follow up on each one every week until it is resolved and confirmed fixed on the live channel. Escalate anything open more than 2 weeks.



Systems admin

9. Onboarding and offboarding: keep an access list of which tools each role needs. Create accounts on a new teammate's first day, and remove every access on their last day.

10. Subscription tracker: keep a list of every tool and app we pay for, its cost, renewal date, and who uses it. Flag renewals 30 days ahead and anything nobody is using.

11. Integration checks: confirm every week that Shopify is syncing stock and listings to every channel, and fix or escalate any sync error the same day. Catch Shopify app failures before they affect orders.

12. Tool documentation: keep a current map of our systems and a how-to guide for every recurring task, so no process lives in one person's head.



Back-end admin

13. Files and folders: keep our Drive organized and files named to our conventions.

14. Weekly channel report: pull a simple sales-by-channel report every week.

15. Retailer documents: upload compliance documents, certificates, and product specs to retailer vendor portals when requested.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

1. You catch what others miss. A wrong UPC, a price off by a dollar, a color named two different ways. You find it before it goes live, every time. That's the #1 thing.

2. 2+ years managing product listings for a brand or seller, with hands-on Amazon flat-file uploads and fixing suppressed or stranded listings.

3. Strong spreadsheet skills: VLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH, filters, data validation, and cleaning messy product data into a template.

4. A builder. When a process was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

5. Clear written English. You'll write support cases, how-to guides, and updates to the team.

6. Steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with a few hours of overlap with US business hours each week.

7. Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus:

1. Mirakl marketplace experience (uploads and fixing rejected products).

2. ESP or SAGE supplier catalog experience: quantity price breaks, imprint and decoration data.

3. Nordstrom or other retailer vendor portals.

4. Google Merchant Center or Meta catalog feeds.

5. Google Workspace or Slack admin: adding and removing users.



WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD

1. Checks the live listing after the upload, not just that the upload went through.

2. Fixes the master sheet first, then the channel, so the same error never comes back.

3. Notices a channel that quietly stopped syncing before a customer does.

4. Removes a departing teammate's access the same day, without being reminded.

5. Writes the how-to the first time they do a task, not the fifth.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you'll be measured on:

- Listing accuracy: zero live errors (price, spec, image, UPC) on any channel

- Health check: every channel checked every week; every issue logged with an owner

- Rewards catalog files: every ATS and image-link file sent monthly, on time, matching live stock

- Open tickets: every ticket followed up weekly; none open past 2 weeks without escalation

- Launch speed: new products and colors live on every channel within 5 business days of approval

- Price changes: live on every channel within 2 business days, with no mismatch between channels

- Access control: new accounts ready on day one; all access removed on a teammate's last day

- Master sheet: every active SKU complete, including units per master carton

- SOP coverage: every recurring task documented



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Part-time and flexible. About 10 hours a week of steady work (health checks, sync checks, access and admin), rising to as many as 20 hours in launch and batch weeks. Paid hourly with a monthly cap agreed in advance. You set your own hours, with a few hours of overlap with US business hours each week for questions.



Competitive pay tied to experience. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

1. Weekly check-in with Michelle (operations), your manager: what launched, what's broken, what's stuck, what's next.

2. Day-to-day coordination with our Operations Coordinator and warehouse team on product data, cartons, and stock.

3. Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word LINEN. Then, in three sentences, tell us about a listing upload that was rejected or went live wrong: what the error was, how you found it, and what you changed so it didn't happen again. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That one line is deliberate. This role is about catching the small detail everyone else skims past, and this is where we see it first.



ABOUT THE TEAM

We're a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

title: Equipment Sourcing & Acquisitions Manager (Facebook Marketplace)
description:
Salary: $6.00 USD / Hour ($960 USD / Month) + Uncapped Profit Share

Shift (Arizona Time): Wednesday – Sunday, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM

Shift (Philippine Time): Thursday – Monday, 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM PHT

Hours: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week)



About the Business:



I run a fast-paced tool and machinery flipping business based in Arizona, USA. We acquire high-value equipment (generators, commercial mowers, pressure washers, power tools) and resell them locally. Because we operate at a high volume, I am looking for a sharp, aggressive, and highly capable Acquisitions Manager. 



Please note: This is not a basic data-entry "scrolling" job. I am paying top-of-market rates because I need someone who can manage the entire digital side of a deal from discovery to final price negotiation.



How You Will Be Paid (Base + 5% Net Profit Share):



I do not want a basic employee; I want a business partner who is hungry to make serious money. Structuring a solid base pay combined with performance bonuses is a proven model for premium remote sales and acquisitions roles.



The Base: You will receive a guaranteed $6.00 USD / Hour ($960/month) just for running the daily operations and showing up to your shift.



The Profit Share: For every machine or tool you source, negotiate, and I successfully flip, I will pay you a 5% commission of the net profit.



The Math: If you find me a Honda EU2000i, negotiate the price down, and I flip it for a $300 profit, you get a $15 bonus on top of your hourly rate just for that one single flip.



Your take-home pay is uncapped. The better you negotiate with sellers, the more money goes directly into your pocket.



The Role (Your Daily Responsibilities):



Full Cycle Deal Management: Actively monitor
 Marketplace, OfferUp, and local classifieds for underpriced equipment using specific keywords. You will not just send me links, you will send the initial offer, handle the seller's pushback, lock in the final price, and schedule the pickup appointment for me.



Margin & Repair Calculation: Calculate strict 2x profit margins before making offers. If a machine needs a minor repair (like a carburetor clean or unloader valve replacement), you must quickly cross-reference the parts cost online and subtract it from your offer.



Inventory Relisting: Once I clean or repair an item, you will use my photos to write optimized, high converting descriptions and manage the incoming buyers so I only deal with serious people ready to hand over cash.



You will be utilizing AI in order to cross reference and verify whether deals are highly profitable or not.



Requirements:



Elite English & Negotiation Skills: You must be highly persuasive and comfortable haggling with American sellers via text/messenger.



Mechanical Aptitude: You don't need to be a mechanic, but you must be able to quickly research small engine parts (e.g., Honda generators, DeWalt tools) to factor repair costs into our buying formulas.



Reliability: High-speed internet, dual monitors (preferred for speed), and strict adherence to the 2:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT shift.



Decisiveness: The ability to make quick, confident decisions on pricing without waiting for my permission on every single item.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):



To prove you have the analytical skills required for this premium role, please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, start your application message with the following test:



Go to
 Marketplace and set the location to Phoenix, Arizona.



Find one active listing for a gas-powered generator or a commercial power tool.



Send me the link to the listing.



Tell me what the seller is asking, tell me what you think it can resell for, and tell me the exact dollar amount you would offer them in your first message.



Applications that do not include this test will be immediately deleted.



*I own a 2 businesses and have always believed the most honorable thing you can do in business is take care of your employees. If you take care of me, I will take care of you.

- Conduct outbound sales through cold
, cold calling, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

- Present Valberg Commerce and Suppro.ae services clearly and professionally.

- Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales process.

- Schedule and conduct sales calls when appropriate.

- Prepare offers and guide prospects through the decision-making process.

- Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities with existing clients.

- Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, follow-ups, opportunities, and sales activities.

- Work closely with the internal team to ensure a smooth handover from sales to project delivery.

- Continuously test and improve outreach strategies, messaging, and prospecting methods.

- Consistently work toward agreed sales targets and KPIs.



What We're Looking For

- Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, lead generation, or outbound sales.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident and professional communication skills.

- Comfortable making cold calls and starting conversations with businesses.

- Strong written communication for cold
 and LinkedIn outreach.

- Highly self-motivated and able to work independently.

- Comfortable researching companies and finding relevant decision-makers.

- Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

- Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

- Ability to handle rejection and remain consistent with outbound activity.

- Basic understanding of eCommerce and online businesses.

- Comfortable working with CRM systems, spreadsheets,
 tools, and other digital sales tools.

- You Don't Need to Be an eCommerce Expert



Our services are clearly structured and easy to understand, with defined pricing and service packages. You don't need to be a technical expert.



What matters most is that you can understand a client's situation, communicate the value of our services, and confidently move a sales conversation forward.



Nice to Have

- Experience selling services to eCommerce businesses.

- Experience with Shopify or other eCommerce platforms.

- Existing network or experience in the US market.

- Experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting.

- Experience using CRMs and sales automation tools.

- Experience selling digital marketing, web development, customer support, or other agency services.



Compensation



This is a fixed + commission-based position.



Fixed Compensation



We offer a small fixed monthly salary combined with performance-based commission.



When applying, please tell us what monthly fixed compensation you would expect.



Commission Structure



You will receive commission on both new business and additional revenue generated from existing clients:



15% commission on every new sale you close.

5% additional commission on revenue generated by that new client in the following month.

Commission on upsells and cross-sells with existing clients that you directly initiate and successfully close.

Additional performance bonuses may be available when agreed sales targets and KPIs are consistently achieved.



The commission structure applies to each new client you acquire, as well as qualifying additional sales you generate within the existing client base.



We believe strong sales performance should be rewarded accordingly. As your results and contribution to the company grow, there is room to increase your overall earning potential.



What We Offer

- Fully remote position.

- Flexible working arrangement.

- Fixed monthly compensation + attractive commission structure.

- Commission opportunities from both new clients and existing client upsells.

- Direct impact on your earning potential through your own sales performance.

- Access to company-provided leads and contacts when available.

- Clear service offerings and transparent pricing.

- International target markets, including the US, UK, and Canada.

- Opportunity to build and manage your own sales pipeline.

- Performance-based bonuses for consistently achieving targets.

- Opportunity to grow into a larger sales or business development role.

- Direct collaboration with an international team.

- Long-term opportunity within a growing eCommerce company.



How to Apply



If you're confident in sales, enjoy outbound prospecting, and want a role where your performance directly impacts your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.



Please send us:



Your CV/Resume

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your previous sales or business development experience

- Your preferred working arrangement

- Your earliest possible start date

- Your expected monthly fixed compensation

- Your previous sales results or KPIs, if available



Optional: a short description of how you would approach acquiring new eCommerce clients in the US market



We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for leads to arrive — someone who actively finds opportunities, starts conversations, and turns them into clients.

title: Full-Time Content Writer and Editor — AI-Assisted Website Content
description:
eWebsites is a boutique digital marketing agency based in Melbourne, Australia. We help Australian businesses attract more enquiries and clients through SEO, websites and useful, persuasive content.



We’re looking for a reliable Content Writer and Editor for a long-term, full-time remote role.



Your main focus will be editing and improving AI-assisted website content, especially service pages, location pages and other commercial content. You’ll also work on blogs and informational articles.



This role requires more than generating a draft and fixing grammar. You need to check facts, improve clarity and structure, remove generic language, understand the customer and make the copy more useful and persuasive.



WHAT YOU’LL GET

US$5–7 per hour, depending on demonstrated skills and experience.

Full-time work: 40 hours per week.

A long-term remote opportunity.

Paid AI tools, writing tools and content-optimisation tools.

Approved briefs, client information, templates, examples and documented processes.

Training in our workflows, with clear feedback to help you improve.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Use Claude, ChatGPT, Rankability and Surfer SEO, following supplied prompts, to support drafting and editing.

Edit AI-assisted drafts into clear, natural, accurate Australian English.

Create and improve service pages, location pages, landing pages, blogs and other website content.

Research unfamiliar topics and verify claims against approved client information and reliable sources.

Improve headings, introductions, service explanations, FAQs and calls to action.

Remove repetition, filler, unsupported claims and generic AI wording.

Follow approved briefs, client tone, templates and quality checklists.

Apply feedback carefully and check revisions before resubmitting.

Keep Asana tasks updated, meet agreed deadlines and raise questions early.

Submit completed content for review with the required checks and handoff information.

You’ll start with content production and editing. As you become confident in our process, you’ll learn to improve and optimise existing website pages.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Excellent written English and strong editing judgement.

Relevant experience writing or editing website content for businesses.

The ability to turn complex information into clear, customer-focused copy.

Careful research and fact-checking skills.

Demonstrated experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools for business website content, including writing and refining prompts, evaluating outputs and manually editing the final copy.

Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow a brief.

Reliable communication, deadline management and willingness to learn from feedback.

Reliable internet access and a suitable computer.

Service-page, landing-page or commercial website editing experience will be particularly useful.

Previous SEO, Surfer or Rankability experience is helpful but not required. We can teach our tools and workflows; you need to bring strong writing, editing and research skills.



HIGH ATTENTION TO DETAIL IS ESSENTIAL

Our work involves detailed briefs, client-specific requirements, documented workflows and pre-submission quality checks. You must be comfortable working carefully through these requirements on every assignment.

Before submitting, you are expected to check your work against the brief, verify factual claims, follow formatting instructions, address feedback and complete the required handoff.

We need someone who catches and corrects avoidable mistakes before review and applies feedback consistently. If instructions are unclear or contradictory, flag the specific issue early. Thoughtful questions and practical suggestions for improving the process are welcome.



You’ll be a strong fit if you:

Enjoy editing and improving content as much as writing it from scratch

Follow a detailed brief precisely rather than treating it as a rough suggestion

Check every AI-assisted draft against the source material before calling it done

Ask a specific question when something’s unclear, instead of guessing

Want a stable, long-term role and work well within structured processes and regular feedback



This role isn’t a fit if you:

Are looking for short-term freelance or project-based work

Submit AI-generated drafts largely as-is, without fact-checking or a full manual edit

Find detailed briefs, templates and QA checklists restrictive rather than helpful

Struggle to meet agreed deadlines or flag problems early

Are unwilling to follow agreed quality checks, receive regular feedback or take responsibility for correcting your work.



HOW WE WORK

The SEO team selects keywords and sets the strategy. The Content Manager provides approved briefs and reviews your work.

You own the writing, editing, verification and pre-submission checks for your assigned content. You won’t be expected to manage the content pipeline, select keywords or publish independently.

If information is missing or contradictory, ask rather than guess. Never invent client services, qualifications, results, testimonials, statistics or guarantees.



WORKING HOURS

You must be available Monday–Friday within the 12 pm–9 pm Melbourne, Australia working window, with breaks arranged to provide 40 working hours per week.

Your availability must follow Melbourne time throughout the year, including daylight-saving changes.



HOW TO APPLY

Complete both steps:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your application message with BLUE HIPPO.

Complete our application form: 



Include your CV and relevant writing or editing samples in the form. Service pages, landing pages and before-and-after editing examples are preferred. Explain what you personally wrote or edited and how AI was used.



We only consider applicants who complete the form and follow the application instructions.



HIRING PROCESS

Application and work-sample review.

A short 5-minute call to confirm spoken English, availability and rate.

A 15-minute interview for shortlisted candidates.

A paid writing and editing assessment for finalists.

Reference checks and final decision.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys improving content, takes accuracy seriously and wants to become a dependable member of our team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Respond promptly to inbound inquiries from phone, text, website, Google Local Services Ads, and social media.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong spoken and written English and a warm, confident phone presence.

• Organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and able to handle customer conversations professionally while juggling follow-ups and scheduling.

• Cleaning or other home-services experience is preferred, but not required for someone with strong transferable sales and coordination skills.

• GHL, Quo, ScheduleDrop, or other CRM/scheduling experience is a plus; we can train the right person on our tools and processes.



SCHEDULE

Ongoing remote role, Monday–Friday, 6–8 hours per day (at least 6 hours daily / 30 hours per week). Must have meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours for live lead and cleaner coordination. Please state your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.



PAY AND GROWTH

$4–$6 USD per hour depending on relevant experience, plus commission opportunities tied to performance. We offer opportunities for pay increases and advancement as you perform well, take on more responsibility, and grow with the business. Commission details and performance expectations will be explained during the hiring process.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words “ELITE CLEANING” so we know you read the post. Please include:

1. A brief summary of your phone sales, appointment-setting, and customer-service experience.

2. An example of how you followed a lead from first contact through booking (what you did and the result).

3. The CRM, phone, and scheduling tools you have used.

4. Your weekday availability in U.S. Eastern Time and confirmation that you can work at least 6 hours per day.

5. Any cleaning, home-services, or contractor-coordination experience.

6. A short sample message you would send a cleaner to confirm a job and relay customer notes.

7. Your desired hourly rate within the posted range and any relevant commission experience.

title: US Home Care Cash Poster
description:
PLEASE READ AND WE WILL ACCEPT APPLICATIONS FROM QUALIFIED / EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY. 



Home Care Cash Poster



I. POSITION SUMMARY



Under the direction of the Cash Posting Lead, the Home Care Cash Poster provides centralized cash posting support for home care operations and affiliated agencies.



This role is responsible for reviewing incoming home care deposits and remittance documentation, accurately posting payments and adjustments, reconciling assigned cash logs, identifying and monitoring variances, processing cash-related support tickets, and supporting month-end close activities.



The Home Care Cash Poster works collaboratively with agency representatives and Revenue Cycle partners to obtain missing documentation, resolve routine posting issues, and ensure that home care cash is posted accurately and within established timelines.



The position is responsible for addressing routine cash posting matters and escalating complex or unresolved issues to the Cash Posting Lead as appropriate.



II. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES



Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:



Review assigned home care cash logs daily, reconcile activity, and maintain accurate supporting notes and documentation.



Review incoming home care deposits and remittance documentation and accurately post supported payments and adjustments to the appropriate client, payer, invoice, or account.



Post payments or identify variances within established cash posting timelines and communicate anticipated delays when required documentation is unavailable.



Research home care deposits that lack remittance information or other required documentation and coordinate with agency billers, collectors, leaders, and Revenue Cycle partners to obtain the necessary information.



Identify, document, monitor, and follow up on unapplied home care cash, timing variances, transfers, and other posting exceptions.



Review and process zero-pay remittances and maintain related tracking when offsetting remittances are required before posting.



Process assigned cash posting support tickets, including new deposits, missing payments, posting errors, zero-pay remittances, and missing deposit documentation.



Support month-end closing activities by reconciling and closing assigned cash logs and completing related cash posting responsibilities.



Prepare and maintain cash posting metrics, records, and reports, including days-to-post and manual-versus-electronic posting activity, as assigned.



Communicate clearly and professionally with billers, collectors, agency leaders, Revenue Cycle partners, and other stakeholders regarding cash-related questions and outstanding documentation.



Maintain accurate records and safeguard confidential financial, payer, client, and organizational information.



Follow established cash posting procedures, internal controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, audit standards, and recordkeeping expectations.



Support the implementation and ongoing use of cash posting, electronic remittance, ticketing, reporting, reconciliation, and billing systems, including Wel
rsonal Care or comparable platforms.



Perform other related duties as assigned.



The responsibilities listed above represent the primary duties associated with this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Additional job-related tasks may be assigned based on operational and business requirements.



III. QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS



High school diploma or equivalent required. An associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is preferred.



At least one year of experience in cash posting, accounts receivable, medical billing, home care or healthcare revenue cycle, banking operations, accounting, or a comparable financial support role is preferred.



Experience reviewing payer and private-pay remittance documentation, posting payments and adjustments, and reconciling financial transactions is preferred.



Previous experience supporting multi-location home care operations, home-based care, healthcare organizations, or centralized service operations is an advantage.



Working knowledge of accounts receivable, payment posting, reconciliation, internal controls, and basic accounting principles.



Experience using Wel
rsonal Care or comparable home care billing, electronic medical record, revenue cycle, payment processing, electronic remittance, or ticketing systems is preferred.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams.



IV. PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS



Strong organizational, communication, and follow-through skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain confidentiality.



Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.



Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate payment variances, and resolve routine reconciliation issues.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with operational teams and Revenue Cycle partners.



Ability to follow established processes, maintain accurate documentation, and consistently meet productivity and quality expectations.



V. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT



The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.



This position is primarily performed in a remote work environment and may require occasional travel to operational locations or company meetings based on business needs.



Requires frequent use of a computer, keyboard, telephone, and other standard office equipment.

title: Creative Strategist: AI Animation & Drama Ads | Skincare Brand
description:
Creative Strategist: AI Animation & Drama Ads | Skincare Brand

Starting at $2,000/month + 3% of ad spend on your ads



We’re hiring a hands-on creative strategist for Lumié Paris, a direct-to-consumer skincare brand.



You must be an expert in direct-response marketing, AI animation video ads, and story-driven drama ads. Familiarity with AI tools alone is not enough. We need someone who can develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and turn them into finished ads built to acquire customers.



We will provide specific examples of the creative direction we want.



What you’ll create



Our focus is on two formats:



- AI animation ads: Animated characters, talking products, visual demonstrations, and unexpected concepts that make people stop scrolling.

- Drama ads: Character-led stories with conflict, emotion, suspense, surprises, and a compelling payoff that connects naturally to the product.



We want someone who understands how to make an entertaining story sell. The hook, pacing, product introduction, objection handling, offer, and CTA should all have a purpose.



This role goes beyond basic AI talking-head videos or recycling the same UGC script.



Your responsibilities



- Research customers, competitors, objections, and buying motivations.

- Develop fresh concepts and direct-response angles.

- Write scripts, hooks, scene sequences, and production briefs.

- Produce AI-generated video ads through to finished edits.

- Maintain consistent characters, voices, environments, and product appearance.

- Create meaningful variations and iterate based on performance.

- Explain why an ad worked or failed and what you would test next.



This is a high-output role with substantial ongoing work.** Expect frequent creative production, testing, feedback, and revisions. We’ll agree on weekly deliverables, turnaround times, and availability before starting.



Required experience



- Proven experience creating ads that have received over $100,000 in ad spend.

- A portfolio demonstrating both AI animation and drama/storytelling ads.

- Strong direct-response copywriting and customer psychology expertise.

- Hands-on command of AI video generation, voice, lip-sync, editing, and production workflows.

- Ability to interpret creative performance using metrics such as retention, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS.

- Strong English scriptwriting and natural dialogue.



Skincare, beauty, or comparable DTC experience is highly relevant.



We need evidence of your contribution, not just screenshots of an account you were associated with. Show the creatives, their spend and results, and exactly what you personally handled.



Compensation



ase compensation starts at $2,000 per month, plus 3% of the ad spend on ads you create.



The budget shown on this listing is a starting point, **not a definitive ceiling**. Final compensation will reflect your experience, responsibilities, and agreed workload.



How we’ll start



We will begin with a one-week trial in which you create ads for our brand. Trial scope, compensation, and deliverables will be agreed before it begins.



We’ll evaluate your research, direct-response thinking, originality, execution, communication, and ability to respond to feedback.



Expect questions about your decisions: Why this hook? Why this angle? What objection are you addressing? How does the story lead to the sale? What would you change if retention were strong but conversions were weak?



Your marketing judgment matters as much as your production skills.



References to review before applying



We’ll provide additional animation and drama-ad examples during the selection process.



How to apply



**Start your application with “IAQ” so we know you read the entire post.**



Include:



1. Your portfolio, highlighting AI animation and drama ads.

2. The brands you’ve worked with and your exact responsibilities.

3. Evidence of the $100,000+ ad-spend requirement, including spend per creative, date ranges, and performance results. Redacted evidence is welcome.

4. A brief breakdown of one successful ad: the insight, hook, selling argument, and why you believe it worked.

5. Your AI production tools, weekly capacity, availability, and compensation expectations.



Please apply only if you can demonstrate both strong creative execution and proven direct-response expertise.



Required AI production experience



Hands-on experience with Higgsfield, Seedance 2.5, and Kie.ai is required.



You must show finished AI animation and drama ads you personally worked on, explain your production workflow, and identify exactly what you created.

• Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and a professional telephone manner.



• Excellent written English, including strong grammar, spelling, and reading comprehension.



• Ability to explain technical information and repair instructions clearly and naturally to North American customers.

title: Financial Controller — U.S. Accounting & Financial Planning. U.S. Business / Travel Marketplace
description:
Livily is a corporate travel marketplace connecting business travelers with professionally managed vacation rentals. We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Chief Financial Officer to partner directly with the CEO and lead financial strategy, reporting, cash management, and the finance team as the business scales.



This role combines executive judgment with detailed financial execution. You should be comfortable building financial models, reviewing reconciliations, improving accounting processes, and turning financial data into clear business decisions.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, and a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast.

• Lead timely monthly closes and accurate profit-and-loss, balance-sheet, and cash-flow reporting across multiple entities, including intercompany reconciliations and consolidated reporting.

• Oversee the accounting team, external accountants, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll coordination, and reconciliations.

• Build management dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, operating expenses, working capital, and performance against budget.

• Improve booking-to-cash reconciliation across customer collections, payment processors, booking channels, refunds, commissions, and property-manager payouts.

• Strengthen revenue-recognition processes, internal controls, payment approvals, financial SOPs, and audit readiness.

• Evaluate channel economics, pricing, marketing spend, hiring plans, and growth investments; explain the financial implications to leadership.

• Manage banking relationships and financing analysis, and prepare lender, board, and investor reporting when needed.

• Coordinate U.S. tax and compliance work with external CPAs and advisors.

• Develop the finance team, establish clear ownership and deadlines, and use automation to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including 5+ years leading a finance function as CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, or equivalent.

• Strong experience supporting U.S. businesses, with working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and multi-entity accounting.

• Proven ability to manage cash flow, build integrated financial models, and deliver reliable forecasts and executive reporting.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and strong QuickBooks Online experience.

• Excellent written and spoken English, strong business judgment, and confidence challenging assumptions with evidence.

• A hands-on approach, high attention to detail, and a record of improving accountability and financial processes.

• Degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CMA, or equivalent qualification strongly preferred.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Travel, hospitality, vacation rentals, online marketplaces, SaaS, or other transaction-heavy businesses.

• Payment processor reconciliation, chargebacks, partner payouts, and marketplace unit economics.

• Fundraising support, due diligence, lender reporting, or acquisition analysis.

• Business intelligence tools and finance automation.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

• Remote, Philippines-based.

• Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week.

• Regular overlap with U.S. business hours is required; exact schedule to be agreed.

• Reports directly to the CEO.

• Compensation is negotiable based on experience and qualifications.



FIRST 90 DAYS

• Assess financial reporting, cash visibility, close processes, and internal controls.

• Establish a reliable cash forecast and a clear monthly reporting package.

• Identify priority reconciliation issues, margin opportunities, and process improvements, with owners and deadlines.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

1. Your resume and relevant professional qualifications.

2. A brief summary of the U.S. businesses you have supported, your leadership responsibilities, and the size of the finance teams you have managed.

3. Two specific examples of how you improved cash flow, profitability, reporting, or financial controls, including measurable results where possible.

4. Your experience with QuickBooks Online, multi-entity accounting, financial modeling, and marketplace or hospitality finance.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD, availability to start, and availability for U.S. working-hour overlap.



Use “CFO – Livily” as your application subject. Please anonymize examples and do not include confidential information from current or former employers.

title: Apprentice Coordinator - Bonus if you have Financing Experience
description:
About Ink Different Apprenticeships

Ink Different Apprenticeships is America’s only national tattoo apprenticeship. We’ve been training tattoo artists for fifteen years, work with artists seen on shows like Ink Master and Tattoo Rescue, and have grown from five locations in 2023 to nearly seventy today. We are growing fast, and we are hiring for people who will grow with us.



If you have applied for this role before, please do not reapply.



This is a highly competitive position

We review every application carefully and choose very few. If you are looking for an easy part-time job you can fit around other work, this is not the role for you. If you want a long-term position with a real path into leadership, and you can prove your skills, keep reading.



What you’ll do



* Run monthly apprentice check-ins, follow-ups, and documentation

* Maintain detailed trackers in Google Sheets and Google Docs, and keep records accurate. 

* Cross-check records for errors, inconsistencies, and patterns, and report what you find, while also figuring out solutions to present to your team lead

* Write clear, professional
s to apprentices that balance empathy with directness

* Send payment-related notices, including suspension and unsuspension
s, based on information from our finance team

* Communicate across departments without fear

* Follow SOPs exactly, and use good judgment when something doesn’t look right



Spreadsheet skills are required, and you will be tested

This role lives in GOOGLE spreadsheets & docs. Changing fonts, colors, and copying and pasting is not enough. If you are chosen for an interview, you will complete a live skills test in Google Sheets and Google Docs. You should be able to:



*Sort, filter, and organize large sets of data

* Compare two sheets and find what doesn’t match

* Build and clean up a tracker from raw information

* Create and format professional documents in Google Docs & Google Sheets

* Also have a minimum typing score of 50 wpm, which will be tested



The skills test is done in Google Sheets and Google Docs. Knowing Microsoft Excel or Word is not a substitute. If you only know Excel and are not already comfortable in Google Sheets/Docs, please do not apply.



If you cannot complete the skills test, the interview will end at that point. We do this so no one’s time is wasted.



We must be your number one

During your scheduled hours, this job comes first. Not second, and not when another job allows it. If you currently have another job, client, or boss who can call you in, change your hours, or pull you away during our required shifts, please do not apply. We are looking for people who make us their priority, show up on time for every shift, and stay focused for the full shift.



What we’re looking for



* Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail

* Strong written communication, with empathy and directness

* Comfort with numbers and financial information

* Someone who thinks critically and investigates before assuming

* Someone who notices problems and speaks up without being asked

* Someone who takes correction well and learns on their own time

* Leadership potential: we will be filling two Team Lead positions, earned through consistent, high-quality work



Requirements



* Moderate to advanced skills in Google Sheets and Google Docs (NOT Microsoft Office Suite knowledge only)

* Typing speed of at least 50 WPM (tested)

* A reliable computer, stable internet, a backup internet connection, and a quiet workspace

* Available Monday through Friday during US Eastern daytime hours, with a start time between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM EST



Schedule and pay



Independent contractor position, with no employee benefits

Starts at [4] hours per day and grows to 6–8 hours per day as training progresses

$4.00 USD per hour for the first 90 days, then $6.00 USD per hour, with yearly raises based on performance

Pay is not negotiable



How our hiring process works



Send your resume and profile. Without a resume, we can’t move forward. Begin the first line of your application message with “I read the full post,” followed by the number of locations we have, your most recent typing test score, and your current work hours in EST (or “not employed”). Applications that don’t follow this will not be reviewed.

If selected, you’ll receive a written questionnaire. Your accuracy on it is the first part of your evaluation.

Top candidates are invited to a live interview that starts with the skills test.

If you pass, we’ll discuss the role in detail.



What’s possible here

A couple of weeks ago, we hired someone who is already working 8 hours a day. They got there by learning fast, staying organized, being accurate, and making this job their first priority from day one.



This is a fast-paced training role, and your hours grow as your accuracy and consistency do. If you’re motivated, organized, and ready to put us first, you can move up just as quickly.



Thanks, and good luck!

description:
About ABL Fitness

ABL Fitness is a growing nonprofit fitness and wellness organization based in Wellesley, Massachusetts. We provide adaptive and inclusive fitness programs for children, teens, adults, and older adults, including individuals with neurodivergence, disabilities, and chronic health conditions.

Our work goes beyond exercise. We help athletes build strength, independence, confidence, and belonging through individualized, evidence-based coaching.

We have incredible stories to tell. We're looking for someone who knows how to tell them.

The Opportunity

We're seeking a creative, proactive social media manager who is an exceptional storyteller and strong writer, not simply someone who edits videos or schedules posts.

You'll turn athlete achievements, organizational milestones, educational content, and real-world outcomes into compelling stories that help us:

Reach local families and increase enrollment in our programs.

Connect with healthcare professionals, donors, corporate sponsors, foundations, and community partners.

Build recognition of our READY ABL Methodology and promote The IEP of Fitness podcast.

Our team provides raw photos, videos, and stories. We also have a dedicated podcast video editor who produces videos and Shorts. Your responsibility is to develop the content strategy, create engaging stories, coordinate existing assets, and manage distribution.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and manage a monthly content calendar across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, YouTube, Tiktok and Google Business Profile.

Write compelling, platform-specific captions, hooks, headlines, and calls to action.

Create engaging Reels, short videos, graphics, and carousels from content provided by our team.

Develop thoughtful LinkedIn content for healthcare professionals, donors, sponsors, and partners.

Promote our podcast and translate the READY ABL Methodology into accessible educational content.

Guide our team on which photos, videos, and athlete stories to capture.

Schedule and publish content, maintain consistent branding, and track results.

Provide a monthly performance report with recommendations.

Expected Monthly Deliverables

Approximately 15–20 hours per week, with an anticipated monthly content package of:

6–8 Reels/short-form videos for Instagram,
, and YouTube.

4–6 LinkedIn posts featuring athlete impact, organizational growth, and thought leadership.

4–6 additional posts including graphics, carousels, and educational content.

4–6 podcast promotional posts using content produced by our existing video editor.

2–4 READY ABL educational posts, which may overlap with other content.

Weekly Google Business Profile updates.

Monthly content calendar, two virtual planning meetings, and performance reporting.

Content can be repurposed across platforms. We value quality, consistency, and meaningful engagement over volume and welcome candidates' recommendations on a realistic content package.

Who We're Looking For

Exceptional English writing and storytelling skills.

Proven experience managing social media for a brand or organization.

Strong understanding of Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.

Ability to create engaging content from existing photos and videos.

Strategic thinker who can work independently and bring creative ideas.

Experience with Canva, CapCut, scheduling tools, and social media analytics.

Bonus: Experience with nonprofits, healthcare, fitness, podcast promotion, SEO, or Google Ad Grants. Google Ads campaign management is not required but may be considered as a separately scoped service.

title: E-Commerce Listing Virtual Assistant – Nifty & Clothing Resale
description:
E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Nifty, eBay, Poshmark, Depop & Whatnot



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time to Start | Opportunity for Full-Time Employment



We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and reliable Virtual Assistant with experience in online resale and e-commerce listing management.



Our business sells vintage, secondhand, and new clothing across multiple online marketplaces, including eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Whatnot. We use the Nifty platform to help manage our online selling operations.



You will receive daily product photos and sizes from our team. Your job will be to research each item, find comparable sold listings, gather additional product photos when needed, and create accurate, appealing product listings across our marketplaces using our established workflow.



We typically have 25–50 new items to process daily, so we need someone who is efficient, consistent, and comfortable working with a high volume of products.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our team as our business grows.



Responsibilities



Product Research & Pricing



Research each item using brand, style, size, keywords, and other identifying details.



Find comparable sold listings (comps) to help determine competitive pricing.



Research brands, product names, styles, vintage details, and relevant keywords.



Recommend pricing based on comparable sales, condition, demand, and marketplace trends.



Identify items with valuable brands, vintage appeal, or higher resale potential.



Listing Creation & Cross-Listing



Use Nifty to create and manage product listings across eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Whatnot.



Write clear, engaging, search-friendly titles and descriptions.



Enter accurate sizes, brands, colors, conditions, measurements, and other item specifics based on the information provided.



Select relevant categories, attributes, tags, and keywords for each platform.



Upload the provided product photos and source appropriate additional images when needed and permitted.



Ensure listings are complete, accurate, and formatted appropriately for each marketplace.



Review listings for errors before publishing.



Follow our established workflow to avoid duplicate listings and inaccurate inventory.



Daily Workflow & Organization



Process approximately 25–50 new items per day, depending on listing complexity.



Keep product information organized and ensure every item is accounted for.



Flag missing information, unclear photos, potential valuable finds, and items requiring additional research.



Track completed listings and report any issues or delays.



Maintain consistency across all platforms and follow instructions carefully.



Required Qualifications



Previous experience with Nifty is strongly preferred.



Hands-on experience with eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Whatnot is highly desirable.



Experience with clothing resale, vintage fashion, thrift stores, or online marketplaces is a major plus.



Ability to research sold comps and understand resale pricing.



Strong written English and the ability to write natural, accurate product descriptions.



Excellent attention to detail, especially with sizes, brands, measurements, and condition.



Ability to work efficiently with high volumes of listings.



Comfortable learning new tools and following standard operating procedures.



Reliable internet connection and consistent daily communication.



Ability to work independently and meet daily production goals.



Preferred Skills



Familiarity with vintage and contemporary clothing brands.



Knowledge of men's, women's, and children's clothing, including sizing conventions.



Experience identifying vintage items, styles, fabrics, and brand labels.



Familiarity with SEO keywords for marketplace listings.



Experience using Canva, image editing tools, or photo organization software.



Ability to recognize when an item may be worth more than its typical resale price.



Compensation & Growth



Remote position based in the Philippines.



Part-time to start, with the possibility of full-time employment as the business grows.



Compensation based on experience, listing quality, and efficiency.



Opportunity for increased hours and compensation for consistent, high-quality performance.



We value accuracy and quality just as much as speed. We want someone who can help us build organized, professional listings that attract buyers and increase sales.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Have you used Nifty before? If so, describe your experience.



Which of these platforms have you personally managed: eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Whatnot?



Have you worked with clothing resale, thrift stores, or vintage products?



How do you research sold comps and determine a competitive listing price?



How many complete clothing listings can you accurately create in a typical workday?



Are you comfortable processing 25–50 new products daily?



What hours are you available to work, and what compensation are you seeking?



Please share examples of product listings you have created or managed, if available.



Application instruction: Start your application with the words “NIFTY LISTING VA” so we know you have read the entire posting.



We are looking for a dependable team member who takes pride in their work, communicates well, and wants to grow with a growing resale business.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
We are hiring a motivated and personable Appointment Setter to join our event planning team.



We specialize in proposals, weddings, elopements, private celebrations, corporate events, and custom experiences. We are looking for someone who is confident communicating with potential clients, understands how to have a natural conversation, and can turn qualified inquiries and leads into scheduled consultations.



This is a part-time to full-time opportunity for someone who is proactive, organized, and comfortable communicating with clients. Working hours begin at 10:00 AM EST.



Responsibilities:



* Research potential clients and identify relevant leads

* Contact potential clients by phone,
, social media, and other communication channels

* Introduce our event planning services and establish initial contact

* Have friendly and professional conversations with potential clients

* Ask basic questions to understand the client's event, date, location, guest count, and general needs

* Identify clients who are interested and suitable for a consultation

* Schedule consultations with our event planning team

* Follow up with interested leads who have not yet scheduled

* Keep lead information and follow-up communication organized

* Update lead status and appointment information

* Maintain consistent outreach and follow-up



Requirements:



* Strong English communication skills

* Confident and professional speaking style

* Comfortable speaking with potential clients over the phone

* Friendly, personable, and able to build rapport quickly

* Strong listening skills and ability to ask appropriate questions

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Self-motivated and able to work independently

* Reliable and consistent with follow-ups

* Previous experience in appointment setting, lead generation, customer service, hospitality, or event planning is a plus



Important:



This is not a sales-closing position.



Your main responsibility will be to connect with potential clients, understand their basic needs, qualify their interest, and schedule consultations with our event planning team. You will not be expected to create proposals, negotiate pricing, or close the event.



Because our clients are often planning important occasions such as proposals, weddings, and celebrations, professionalism, patience, and a warm communication style are very important for this position.

* Part-time to full-time opportunity

title: Virtual CIO (vCIO) – Strategic IT Consultant
description:
We are seeking a strategic and business-minded Virtual CIO (vCIO) to serve as a high-level advisor for our diverse portfolio of business clients. In this role, you will act as an extension of our clients' executive teams, bridging the gap between their business goals and their technology infrastructure.



As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

*Strategic IT Roadmapping & Planning

- Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clients to align technology with their 1–3 year business goals.

- Develop and maintain comprehensive IT roadmaps, including hardware lifecycle management, cloud migrations, and

security enhancements.

- Identify emerging technologies that can provide a competitive advantage or operational efficiency for specific client

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Assist clients in developing and managing annual IT budgets.

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

- Oversee client security postures, ensuring alignment with frameworks like NIST, CIS, or industry-specific regulations

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience with ITIL frameworks or MSP-specific vCIO tools.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?



*Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

*Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work while contributing to impactful projects.



How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your IT career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join a team that’s passionate about technology, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

title: Support Specialist- Travel SaaS Technical Support
description:
You aren't answering tickets or calls to just hit a metric, you are the frontline voice that directly shapes our product and user experience. The support team is the foundation that determines whether our users will succeed. You will help shape the future of support by rethinking and influencing how support should operate in the age of AI. If this sounds like you, we'd love to talk.



**Tern is moving to a 24/7 support model as our global user base grows. This role could include shifts outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends. We'll share specific schedule expectations during the interview process. Ideally we need 2 individuals to support US night shifts and weekends (daytime in PH).



ABOUT TERN

Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it.vNearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically

underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel. But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of. At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.



Support Specialist

The support team at Tern is the foundation that determines whether our advisors and agencies

succeed on the platform. Most support orgs at this scale are still reacting and focusing support

solely on the queue. More tickets, more headcount, repeat. Tern is different. AI is embedded into

almost every single workflow as a force multiplier for our human team and it's most critical on

the support function. And, with AI supporting the majority of our customer service volume, our

expert team of ICs can be deployed elsewhere where the human touch really matters. If you’re

looking to be at the forefront of our mission to empower travel advisors with innovative

technology, making their work more efficient and their impact more significant, and equally help

define what our support org will look like long term, this role is for you. You will provide top-tier

support to our partners, troubleshoot technical issues, become an expert in our product and AI

capabilities, and collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Customer Support: Be a champion for our customers, representing their needs within Tern and ensuring their voices are heard by providing prompt, professional, and effective support to travel advisors, resolving issues and ensuring their success with Tern's solutions primarily through chat, phone,
, and 1:1's.

- Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical problems, providing expert guidance and clear communication

- Product Mastery: You are quick to learn and navigate complex technology platforms, and you enjoy staying ahead of the curve. You'll become a Tern product expert, using your knowledge to assist customers and provide valuable feedback to our internal

teams.

- Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain clear, comprehensive support documentation to help users find answers quickly

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering to surface relevant feedback on our offerings and ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our roadmap

- Continuous Improvement with AI: Build and deploy ways to enhance our support processes and overall customer experience to be improved, using AI and automation tooling to improve your personal productivity as well as the team’s



WHAT YOU HAVE

-Customer-obsession: You genuinely care about making life easier for our users and are committed to learning about our users, product, and team in depth to make that possible. You'll be the frontline voice of our customers- your problem solving and insights will directly influence product development and customer retention

-Customer phone calls: You're experienced taking customer phone calls in high-pressure/time-sensitive situations, know how to de-escalate, can multitask to find information

- Previous travel industry experience: Whether you've worked for an online travel

agency, have been or are a travel advisor 

-Technical curiosity and strong communication: While you don't need to be an engineer, familiarity with APIs, AI, and automation tools is a big plus. Even if you don’t know how to use each of these resources, you’re willing and eager to dig in. You can translate technical concepts into easy-to-understand language for non-technical users.

- User-facing enablement: You’re just as comfortable in the queue as you are creating a walk through video or hosting a live 1-1 training to close the ticket. You deploy the right lever for the right problems to resolve issues quickly and effectively.

-A fast learner: You pick up new tools, concepts, and workflows quickly, and you thrive in fast-moving, high-energy environments. You know how to approach becoming an expert in our product quickly, understanding both the technical and strategic ways advisors use it.

-Startup mindset: You're scrappy, adaptable, and ready to figure things out. You thrive on solving problems and are known for your attention to detail. You are comfortable in a fast-paced environment and can easily shift priorities as needed.

NICE-TO-HAVE

-Travel enthusiast: A love for travel is a plus; understanding the travel industry helps you connect with our customers on a deeper level. Having professional experience in the industry is a huge plus.

-Proficiency in support automations: You have the reps and excitement to build smarter workflows, leverage AI, and create self-service solutions to make support faster and more efficient

-Experience in SaaS support: Prior customer support experience is preferred, but we care more about raw talent and drive than years of experience.



WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT TERN

-Growth potential: Our team has an outsized impact at a quickly scaling company. This is your chance to get in early, grow fast, and learn.

-Work with the best: Join a team of top-tier engineers, designers, and operators building the future of travel tech

-Make an impact: Your work will directly shape the experience of thousands of travel advisors and their clients

Be a part of the hustle: Expect to wear multiple hats, learn quickly, and embrace the fast-paced nature of startup life



BONUS POINTS

-Experience providing technical or phone support for SaaS applications, preferably experience with Tern

-Experience in the travel industry

-Experience with Tern's primary tools: Intercom, Notion, Slack

-Experience utilizing AI



WHAT WE 

🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity.

🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve.

💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust.

Operating Principles:

👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in.

➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now"

📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego.

🧭 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality.

🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last.
