title: Medical Billing and Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
About the Job

Pacific Mind Health is an established outpatient mental health practice seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and compassionate professional to join our virtual team. We are committed to providing a patient-centered healthcare experience built on respect, integrity, teamwork, and exceptional service.



We are seeking an experienced Medical Billing & Prior Authorization Specialist to join our U.S.-based mental health practice. The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of U.S. prior authorization or medical billing experience, strong commercial and Medicare insurance knowledge, and expertise in claims processing, denial management, insurance verification, and prior authorizations.



This role focuses on prior authorizations for our interventional psychiatry treatments (TMS and SPRAVATO® esketamine) and also includes medical billing responsibilities, requiring someone who can manage both processes accurately and efficiently. Responsibilities include processing claims, investigating denials, submitting appeals, following up on outstanding payments, verifying insurance eligibility and benefits, and managing prior authorizations from submission through approval. You will also help resolve authorization denials and monitor authorization expiration dates and service limits to prevent treatment interruptions.



Experience with Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) or SPRAVATO® (esketamine) authorizations, including buy-and-bill and specialty pharmacy requests, is strongly preferred but not required. A clinical background (such as nursing, pharmacy, or medical assistant experience) and comfort speaking with patients are also a plus.



This is a full-time remote position, working Monday through Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. Candidates must be available during Pacific Time (PT) business hours.



Key Responsibilities

● Review clinical charts and provider notes, gather medical necessity documentation, and submit complete, accurate prior authorization requests through online insurance payer portals or by phone.

● Verify patient insurance eligibility, behavioral health benefits, coverage limitations, authorization requirements, and applicable payer medical policies.

● Review clinical documentation, diagnoses, treatment history, and supporting records to ensure authorization requests meet payer-specific medical necessity criteria.

● Track pending authorizations in a shared tracking log, record each payer's expected decision timeframe, follow up with insurance companies and specialty pharmacies within that window, resolve outstanding requirements, and communicate approval status and next steps to providers and staff.

● Identify missing or insufficient clinical documentation and coordinate with providers to obtain the information needed to support authorization approval.

● Investigate authorization denials, determine the reason for denial, and coordinate resubmissions, appeals, and peer-to-peer reviews when appropriate.

● Monitor authorization expiration dates, approved service limits, and reauthorization requirements to help prevent interruptions in patient care.

● Coordinate authorization requirements and scheduling considerations with clinical and administrative teams to minimize treatment delays.

● Manage authorizations for our interventional treatments, including Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) and SPRAVATO® (esketamine) through both buy-and-bill (medical benefit) and specialty pharmacy (pharmacy benefit) pathways. TMS and SPRAVATO® experience is strongly preferred but not required.

● Process and submit accurate medical insurance claims, monitor accounts receivable, and follow up on denied, rejected, underpaid, and unpaid claims.

● Investigate authorization-related claim denials, correct billing errors, submit appeals, and communicate with insurance companies to resolve payment issues and recover outstanding revenue.

● Understand CPT codes, ICD-10-CM codes, and applicable modifiers relevant to billing and authorization requests.

● Review explanations of benefits (EOBs) and payment records, maintain accurate documentation, and track authorization and billing outcomes.

● Explain patient financial responsibility, collect patient balances, and respond to billing questions professionally and compassionately.

● Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements when handling clinical records, insurance information, and billing documentation.

● Communicate effectively with patients, providers, insurance representatives, and team members.

● Perform additional administrative and/or billing responsibilities as assigned.



Qualifications

● 3+ years of recent U.S. healthcare or mental health prior authorization or medical billing experience required.

● Experience with mental health services, psychiatric practices, or specialty healthcare settings strongly preferred; a clinical background (such as nursing, pharmacy, or medical assistant experience) is a plus.

● Strong experience with U.S. commercial and Medicare insurance plans and major insurance carriers.

● Hands-on experience with prior authorizations, including reviewing clinical records, gathering medical necessity documentation, and submitting requests through payer portals or by phone.

● Experience with insurance eligibility verification and prior authorizations for specialty treatments such as TMS or SPRAVATO® strongly preferred.

● Working knowledge of CPT codes, ICD-10-CM codes, modifiers, and medical necessity documentation.

● Ability to review clinical notes and identify documentation needed to support claims and authorization requests.

● Experience with Tebra/Kareo or a comparable EMR and medical billing system.

● Strong computer, organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.

● Working knowledge of HIPAA and patient privacy requirements.

● Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

● Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

● Reliable high-speed internet connection required.



Additional Skills & Competencies

● Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written (English) communication with patients, providers, and external vendors through phone,
, and virtual platforms.

● Prior Authorization Management: Review clinical charts, gather required medical necessity documentation, and submit complete, accurate prior authorization requests through online insurance payer portals or by phone.

● Clinical Documentation Review: Review provider notes, diagnoses, treatment history, and supporting clinical records to identify documentation needed to meet insurance coverage and medical necessity requirements.

● Insurance Eligibility & Benefits Verification: Verify patient coverage, behavioral health benefits, authorization requirements, treatment limitations, deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance.

● Authorization Follow-Up: Track pending authorization requests, contact insurance companies for status updates, resolve outstanding requirements, and communicate approval status and next steps to the clinical team.

● Denial Resolution & Appeals: Investigate authorization denials, identify missing documentation or unmet payer criteria, and coordinate resubmissions, appeals, and peer-to-peer reviews with providers when appropriate.

● Provider & Team Coordination: Work closely with psychiatrists, therapists, and administrative staff to obtain supporting clinical documentation and prevent unnecessary delays in treatment.

● Authorization Tracking & Compliance: Maintain accurate records of authorization submissions, approvals, denials, expiration dates, and approved service limits while protecting patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

● Billing & Reimbursement Support: Identify authorization-related claim denials, research payer requirements, and coordinate resolution to help ensure timely reimbursement.

● TMS & SPRAVATO® Authorization Support: Manage prior authorizations for Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) and SPRAVATO® (esketamine), including buy-and-bill and specialty pharmacy requests. Familiarity with TMS and SPRAVATO® coverage policies and medical necessity criteria is strongly preferred but not required.

● Self-Motivation & Accountability: Proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote healthcare environment. Takes ownership of authorizations and billing issues, works out the right payer forms, portals, and submission steps independently, follows through on pending requests and outstanding claims, and communicates potential problems promptly.

● Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using:

o Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems (e.g., Tebra, Kipu, DrChrono)

o Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

o CRM, phone system and workflow management tools (e.g., Asana, HubSpot, Dialpad)

o Dropbox and other secure document management tools

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) U.S. Executive Career Services | Part-time | Philippines
description:
About Executive Career Partners



Executive Career Partners (ECP) is an established U.S.-based executive career services company with 40 years of experience helping accomplished professionals and senior leaders advance their careers and navigate career transitions.

As our sales and marketing organization grows, we're looking for a talented Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in the Philippines to engage prospective clients and schedule qualified consultations with our Advisors.

This is not an entry-level virtual assistant or administrative role, nor is it a hard-closing sales position. It is a client-facing prospect engagement role requiring excellent communication, professionalism, organization, and follow-through.



The Role

Your primary responsibility is to engage, qualify, and book prospective clients for consultations with ECP Advisors.

Most prospects have already expressed interest in ECP through our marketing. You'll connect with them through a combination of phone,
, and text/SMS, conduct surface-level qualification, and schedule appropriate prospects with our Advisors.

You'll also confirm appointments, reduce no-shows, reschedule cancellations, follow up with unresponsive leads, and occasionally re-engage older opportunities. As the role grows, outreach may also include social media and direct messaging.

The goal is not to pressure or close prospects. It's to create professional conversations, understand why they reached out, determine whether an Advisor conversation makes sense, and help qualified prospects take the next step.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond quickly and professionally to new inbound leads

• Contact prospects through phone,
, and text/SMS

• Conduct surface-level discovery and qualification

• Book qualified appointments directly onto Advisor calendars

• Consistently follow up with prospects who haven't responded

• Confirm appointments and help maximize show rates

• Reschedule cancellations and no-shows

• Re-engage aged leads and previous opportunities when appropriate

• Maintain accurate prospect records and follow-up activity in Salesforce

• Coordinate with Advisors/Closers regarding scheduled prospects

• Manage scheduling through Google Calendar and related tools

• Assist with CRM organization, lead management, reporting, and related sales support as needed

• Potentially expand into social media/DM outreach and deeper qualification over time



What Success Looks Like

The #1 measure of success is qualified appointments booked for ECP Advisors, along with the quality and show rate of those appointments.

Performance will also be measured by consistent lead follow-up, appointment confirmations and rescheduling, professional prospect communication, accurate CRM management, and strong follow-through.

Specific activity and performance targets will evolve as ECP's sales and marketing organization grows.



What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is confident, professional, persistent, organized, highly coachable, and comfortable communicating with accomplished U.S. professionals and executives.

You don't need to be an experienced U.S.-level salesperson, but this is not an entry-level appointment-setting position. You should have previous client-facing experience and be comfortable initiating conversations and following up until you receive an answer.



Qualifications

• 1+ years of sales, customer service, appointment setting, business development, or other client-facing experience preferred

• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication

• Confident phone presence and ability to communicate comfortably with Director, VP, and C-suite professionals

• Comfortable with outbound calls,
, and text/SMS follow-up

• Strong listening and interpersonal skills

• Persistent without being pushy or overly sales-oriented

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Comfortable using CRM and scheduling technology

• Salesforce experience preferred; other CRM experience is valuable

• Comfortable with Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, phone/SMS platforms, and similar business tools

• Social media/DM outreach experience helpful but not required

• Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work environment

• Coachable, accountable, and able to learn new processes quickly



Schedule

This is a part-time remote contractor position based in the Philippines that will transition to full-time.

Typical hours will align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time to allow direct communication with U.S.-based prospects. Some flexibility may be available depending on business needs and circumstances.



Growth Opportunity

ECP has been serving professionals and executives for approximately 40 years, and we're continuing to grow our sales and marketing organization.

For the right person, this role can expand beyond appointment setting. Strong performers may have opportunities to take on deeper prospect qualification, higher-level client conversations, sales and business development, lead management, training, and eventually leadership responsibilities.

We're looking for someone who can succeed in the role we're hiring for today while having the ability and ambition to grow with ECP.

title: Junior Media Buyer — Meta Ad Launching (Adnova)
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC health supplement company running several brands. We spend around $70K per day on Meta across multiple ad accounts, and our creative team (strategists, video editors, static designers) ships 100+ new creative batches every week. Our goal for next year is $100M in revenue, and fast, accurate ad launching is one of the engines behind it.

We already have one Junior Media Buyer and a Senior Media Buyer. Creative volume has grown so fast that we need a second launcher to keep the queue clear every day.

The role

You turn finished creatives into live ads. Strategists hand over batches in Notion, you build and launch them in our Meta ad accounts using Adnova, and the Senior Media Buyer reviews what you staged. On a normal day that means 50–120 ads launched across several ad accounts, with zero mistakes in naming, landing pages or copy.

You report to the Senior Media Buyer and work closely with our Operations Manager and Creative Strategists.

What you'll do

Launch ads every day

- Pick up every batch marked "Ready to Launch" in Notion and clear the queue before the end of your shift

- Launch in the priority order set by the Senior Media Buyer: usually winners first, then seasonal/promo batches, then new test batches

- Build ads in Adnova in the right ad account, campaign and ad set, starting from our template ad sets

- Follow our naming convention exactly (ad set number, product/angle, format, date) so reporting stays clean

- Attach the correct primary text, headline, description and
 Page to every ad, and stay within the ad limit per Page

- Pick the right landing page for each ad based on product, brand and awareness level (advertorial for unaware/problem/solution aware, product page for product/most aware, language-specific pages for e.g. Spanish ads)

- Switch ad sets on and double-check budgets, campaign type (CBO) and settings before you sign off

Move and re-stage winners

- Duplicate winning ads into other ad accounts using post IDs, so we keep their social proof

- Help migrate campaigns quickly when an ad account or page gets restricted, so spend doesn't drop

Quality-check every brief before it goes live

- Check each Notion card is complete: creative files, ad copy, headline, Page and landing page

- Flag missing items to the right strategist straight away in our launch channel

- When a deadline is tight, solve it yourself: use the winner's original copy or our approved fallback copy for that product and awareness level, and keep moving

Report and communicate

- Send an end-of-day report: ads launched per ad account, total launched, remaining backlog, and the list of staged ad sets for review

- Flag blockers early and tag the right people in one message so decisions happen fast

Spot problems in the accounts

- Recognise and escalate Adnova and Meta errors (account authentication, terms that need accepting, disapproved ads, page limits)

- Know the basic workarounds in Ads Manager so a single error doesn't stop the whole launch

Big promo pushes

- Launch time-sensitive campaigns like Prime Day, Halloween and Black Friday on tight deadlines

- Be available for a few extra hours (sometimes on a Saturday) around these key moments

What we're looking for

- 1+ year hands-on experience launching ads in Meta Ads Manager at volume

- Experience with Adnova (or a similar bulk ad-launching tool). Adnova is a big plus

- Extremely detail-oriented: you get naming, links and copy right the first time

- Solution-oriented: when something is missing, you find the answer instead of waiting

- Comfortable working from Notion boards and communicating in Slack

- Clear written English

- Comfortable using AI tools (like Claude) to work faster

- Reliable and available for a full shift that overlaps with US hours

Nice to have

- Experience in DTC supplements or health, and an understanding of Meta's health-claim policies

- Experience working across multiple Business Managers and ad accounts

- Familiarity with Triple Whale or similar attribution tools

What we offer

- Fully remote, ~8 hours per day, weekends off (except occasional promo pushes)

- Compensation: [fill in monthly rate], paid twice a month

- A front-row seat in a team spending $2M+ per month on Meta, with room to grow into a full media buyer role

- Direct access to the Senior Media Buyer and founder: fast answers, no corporate layers

How to apply

Send us:

- Your CV or LinkedIn

- A short Loom (2–3 minutes) answering: "A batch of 20 ads is due live tonight for a sale, but 6 of them are missing a headline and the strategist is offline. What do you do?"

- Your experience with Adnova or other bulk-launch tools, and roughly how many ads per day you've launched

Please start your application with the words "Launch Ready" so we know you read the full post.

title: Experienced U.S. Trucking Dispatcher (Remote) — Full-Time
description:
EXPERIENCED U.S. TRUCKING DISPATCHER | REMOTE | FULL-TIME



Compensation: $700–$800 USD/month + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 40 Hours/Week

Time Zone: U.S. Pacific Time (Flexible Schedule)

Engagement: Independent Contractor

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We are a U.S.-based transportation and logistics company headquartered in Southern California, specializing in trucking and freight transportation.



We currently operate a small fleet with plans for continued growth. We are seeking an experienced dispatcher to take ownership of our daily freight sourcing and dispatch operations.



This position will initially support two trucks and work directly with company ownership. As our operations expand, there will be opportunities to assume greater responsibility in dispatch management, operational planning, and potentially customer development.



We value reliability, responsiveness, adaptability, and strong problem-solving skills. Our goal is to build a disciplined, efficient, and scalable transportation operation.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



POSITION OVERVIEW



Your primary responsibility will be to find, evaluate, negotiate, and book profitable freight for our trucks using U.S. freight load boards.



We operate primarily in the spot freight market. Because opportunities appear throughout the day, this position requires active load-board monitoring, quick responses, and sound operational judgment.



You must be comfortable working independently within established guidelines while communicating clearly when a decision requires approval.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT an entry-level dispatch assistant position. We are specifically seeking someone with hands-on experience sourcing, negotiating, and booking U.S. trucking freight.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. FREIGHT SOURCING & NEGOTIATION



• Monitor freight load boards, including DAT and similar platforms.

• Identify suitable loads based on equipment, rates, deadhead, location, and scheduling.

• Contact brokers, negotiate competitive rates, and book approved freight.

• Proactively secure reloads and plan upcoming truck availability.

• Evaluate load profitability and operational feasibility.

• Identify valuable freight lanes, brokers, and recurring opportunities.



2. DISPATCH OPERATIONS



• Coordinate pickup and delivery information with drivers and brokers.

• Monitor load progress and communicate scheduling changes.

• Consider hours-of-service availability, transit times, and appointment requirements.

• Maintain accurate load details and dispatch records.

• Escalate operational conflicts and unusual situations promptly.



3. TRANSPORTATION ADMINISTRATION



• Organize rate confirmations, BOLs, PODs, and related documentation.

• Update transportation management systems, spreadsheets, and internal records.

• Assist with broker communications and documentation follow-up.

• Support operational reporting and administrative processes.



4. PROCESS IMPROVEMENT



• Help develop efficient and repeatable dispatch procedures.

• Prepare basic operational and performance reports.

• Use AI tools appropriately for research, drafting, reporting, and workflow improvements.

• Identify opportunities to improve freight coverage, profitability, and efficiency.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



✓ Previous professional experience dispatching freight for U.S. trucking companies.

✓ Proven experience independently sourcing, negotiating, and booking loads.

✓ Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards and broker communications.

✓ Understanding of dry van operations, deadhead, rate per mile, transit planning, and HOS.

✓ Excellent spoken and written English.

✓ Strong organization, attention to detail, and responsiveness.

✓ Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions.

✓ Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and suitable headset.

✓ Willingness to learn new systems and AI-assisted workflows.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



+ Experience with DAT, Truckstop, TMS platforms, or ELD systems.

+ Experience dispatching multiple trucks and planning reloads.

+ Knowledge of freight documentation, factoring, and transportation compliance.

+ Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools.

+ Broader logistics, transportation, or freight brokerage experience.

+ Spanish communication skills.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WORK SCHEDULE



• Monday–Friday, approximately 40 working hours per week.

• Coverage generally falls between 5:00 AM and 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

• Daily hours vary depending on truck availability and freight requirements.

• Some days require earlier starts; others require later coverage.

• Schedules will be coordinated in advance, with reasonable flexibility and breaks.



Applicants must be comfortable working hours aligned with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



• Starting compensation: $700–$800 USD/month, based on experience.

• Additional performance-based bonus opportunities.

• Work directly with company ownership.

• Opportunity to grow into an independent dispatch operations role.

• Potential future involvement in customer development and broader logistics operations.



Performance will be evaluated based on freight sourcing, negotiation quality, operational reliability, communication, and overall contribution.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL five questions in your application:



1. Briefly describe your experience dispatching freight for U.S. trucking companies.



2. How many trucks have you personally dispatched, and what types of equipment have you worked with?



3. Which freight load boards and dispatch systems have you used?



4. Describe a recent load you personally sourced and negotiated. Include the lane, initial broker offer, and final agreed rate, if you remember them.



5. Confirm your availability to work flexible Pacific Time hours and provide your expected monthly compensation.



ATTENTION TO DETAIL:



Include the word "Bluebird" in the SUBJECT LINE of your application.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a brief dispatch-related assessment, followed by interviews.



We are looking for someone with genuine dispatch experience, strong judgment, and a long-term interest in growing with our company.

title: Executive Admin in Marketing (GHL/HubSpot CRM - Remote)
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve automations, documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• GHL / HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Long-term Remote Support Role | Social Media Recruiting Expert (LinkedIn)
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced Social Media Recruiting Expert to source and engage talent through LinkedIn. You’ll work with our hiring team on an ongoing basis to find qualified candidates, start conversations with them, and move strong prospects into our interview pipeline. This is a long-term, fully remote position for someone who knows LinkedIn inside and out and can work independently with minimal oversight.



Responsibilities



Source candidates on LinkedIn using advanced search, Boolean strings, and LinkedIn Recruiter or Sales Navigator

Write and send personalized outreach messages and InMails that get replies

Screen candidate profiles against role requirements and flag the best matches

Manage follow-up sequences and keep response rates healthy

Post open roles and recruiting content on LinkedIn to attract inbound applicants

Build and maintain talent pools for recurring or hard-to-fill positions

Track candidate status, outreach activity, and results in our ATS or a shared tracker

Coordinate with hiring managers to understand each role and adjust sourcing strategy as needed

Report weekly on pipeline progress, response rates, and candidate quality



Requirements



3+ years of experience in recruiting or talent sourcing, with a strong focus on LinkedIn

Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, or similar tools

Strong Boolean search skills

Excellent written English and a professional, personable messaging style

Experience recruiting for technical, professional, or remote roles

Comfortable working independently across time zones

Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, or similar)

Background in tech, AI, or startup recruiting

Familiarity with LinkedIn content strategy and employer branding

Experience with outreach automation tools, used within LinkedIn’s terms of service



What We Offer



Long-term, stable engagement

Fully remote with flexible hours

Competitive compensation based on experience

Direct collaboration with the hiring team and room to shape our sourcing process



How to Apply



Send your resume or LinkedIn profile along with a short note describing your LinkedIn sourcing experience. If you have examples of outreach messages or results from past campaigns (response rates, placements), please include them.

title: D2C Recruiter/Head Hunter Specialist 8 figure D2C brand
description:
Summary

About Us

We’re a fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) supplement company with eight-figure annual revenue and an ambitious goal of reaching nine figures by Q4. Our products reach customers through Meta, Google, and Amazon.



As we grow, we’re building the people operations and hiring infrastructure to support our next stage. Recruitment is central to that effort.



About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced recruiter with a strong track record in DTC eCommerce. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the talent landscape across marketing, creative, eCommerce, operations, and leadership—and can bring relevant networks and recruiting expertise from day one.



You’ll own hiring for critical roles across the business while helping build the systems, processes, and onboarding practices needed to support continued growth. You’ll work closely with department leaders and have the opportunity to shape how we recruit as the company scales.



Key Responsibilities

Lead full-cycle recruitment across marketing, creative, eCommerce, operations, supply chain, and leadership.

Manage multiple open roles at once while balancing hiring speed with candidate quality.

Source, assess, and engage talent from DTC eCommerce brands, competitors, and adjacent industries.

Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.

Create and improve ATS workflows, hiring dashboards, recruitment SOPs, and HR systems.

Develop scalable recruitment, onboarding, and people-management processes.

Track and improve recruiting metrics, including pipeline conversion, time-to-hire, and quality of hire.

Partner with department heads to clarify role requirements, agree on priorities, and guide hiring decisions.

Contribute to HR infrastructure, documentation, and automation as the team grows.





Requirements

At least three years of in-house recruiting experience at a DTC eCommerce brand. Experience in supplements, health, beauty, or wellness is especially valuable.

Demonstrated success hiring across marketing, creative, eCommerce, operations, and leadership functions.

An established DTC talent network you can activate for relevant searches.

The ability to manage multiple requisitions independently and with minimal oversight.

Hands-on experience building or improving ATS workflows, hiring dashboards, and recruitment SOPs.

A data-informed approach to recruiting, including tracking and improving pipeline conversion, time-to-hire, and quality of hire.

Experience with automation and scalable hiring or onboarding processes.

Sound judgment when evaluating candidates’ skills, experience, and fit for a role.

A proactive, adaptable approach suited to a fast-moving, high-growth business.



Nice to Have

Experience recruiting for Amazon Marketplace, Meta or Google paid media, and 3PL or supply chain roles.

Familiarity with international hiring and remote-team structures.

Experience with employer branding or recruitment marketing.

Experience growing a recruiting function from a small team to five or more recruiters.



Why Join Us

Help shape the team and culture of a business aiming for its next stage of growth.

Work closely with an ambitious, hands-on leadership team.

Build and improve recruiting and HR systems as the company scales.

Make a direct impact on hiring across the business.

Receive a competitive compensation package.



How to Apply

answer these questions:



Which DTC brands have you recruited for in-house, what was their approximate revenue stage, and can you share their websites so we can take a look?



Across your DTC experience, what types of roles have you personally hired for? Walk me through the full range.



How many requisitions were you personally carrying at your busiest, what functions did they span, and how did you prioritize when everything was urgent?



Say we need a senior media buyer with DTC supplement experience. Walk me through exactly how you’d find that person on LinkedIn — how do you identify the right competitors, find the people inside them, and get them to respond?



When you’ve joined a growing company, what’s the first thing you’ve done to get recruiting and onboarding infrastructure in order — and how did you d
 what to prioritize?



Featured Job

40 hrs/week
